notes.title: A Red Sun Rises - interstellar Rift Development Update 141
notes.notes:
Happy new year, and welcome to our first experimental update of 2019! 
This patch today brings you more specialized star systems, and new T1 purchasable star ships for all factions, among other things. 

The specialized star systems will spawn less different resources, but makes them easier to find when you venture to their asteroid belts. We have also  increased the number of stations that can spawn by default in a star system. Previously there was only a small chance to get a static station like the HydroPEX Rift hub. Now you won’t have to build every station in a system, and trade drones will have more targets to go.

Vaultron has now made vault expansion passes available at the Vaultron galactic bank based on your reputation with them. So if you have a high reputation you can purchase higher tier vault expansion passes from them.

And lastly we have made new T1 ships available from the Store-O-Tron for each faction including the new Excavator made by our contest winner Insetricky97. These ships are optimized for their specific roles and should provide players with a more advanced ship than their started counterparts, and help out players who don’t want to build their ships from scratch. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1742231069940211139/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team



PS: We will also be streaming some more Interstellar Rift tonight at 22:00 CET (21:00 UTC) in Dev Stream #40 at https://www.twitch.tv/splitpolygon.

We'll be talking about the changes in this experimental update, and what's going to be in the next update. 

So please join us as we muck about in hyper space and answer all your questions ːsteamhappyː!

notes.title: Building Bridges - interstellar Rift Development Update 140
notes.notes:
All hands to battle stations, this new update delivers to you guys a much anticipated new component; “The Bridge”. The bridge is a new form of cockpit that has seats for 4 players, two pilot stations, the captains chair and an engineering station. The design of this new bridge gives you a very wide field of view as it has very large angled windows.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ebcb0f0838ff9686270f984047cf20ffd1cf7047.jpg

The bridge features a built in holotable for planning and scanning your surroundings, as well as a status screen on the main window. The main new feature of this bridge however is the captain's chair. This new station lets you give orders to your crew by having text appear on the targeted players screen. It lets you set alert states throughout the ship, this will change the lighting and give you a notification as to what alert state you have set. And lastly the captain will have control over the ships self destruct. The self destruct timer is by default set to 5 minutes and can be increased to be as long as necessary but not shortened.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/dedbe6de09ecac9f810a49e97b62160e3421b83e.jpg

And lastly there is an engineering terminal which works exactly like the stand alone one, and can be used to keep an eye on your devices.

We have also made the captain's chair a separate device for you to place wherever you like.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7ffb6c045f3016caebaff6b9c133add077fb8ca7.jpg 

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Once more, we thank you all for playing, and hope see you star-side, in 2019!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Bridge too far - interstellar Rift Development Update 139
notes.notes:
The experimental version of the new update is now live, and brings with it the new bridge as well as several new features that come with the new bridge. 

First up, the new bridge comes in 3 and 4 tile wide variants, so it should fit any ship design regardless of its layout. It offers 3 pilot seats with ship control access, 1 captain’s chair with the new functionalities, and a holotable. It also has a large window display, that will show warp timers and other information. 

Second, the captains chair has now been implemented allowing you to issue commands to your crew, setting custom alarm states for the ship and of course activate the self destruct.
These new features should make it easier to direct the ship in any situation you end up in.

We will also be streaming some more Interstellar Rift tonight at 22:00 CET (21:00 UTC) in Dev Stream #37 at https://www.twitch.tv/splitpolygon.

notes.title: Padding out the cargo! - interstellar Rift Development Update 138
notes.notes:
Another patch is ready for prime time! This time we include the new vault limitation and cargo systems. 

This patch will limit the default vault capacity to only 500 crates. The capacity can be expanded however through the use of Vaultron passes. These can be bought from faction vendors. The vault passes come in a variety of tiers. Low tiers can be bought at the faction desks in starting systems. However for the higher tier ones players will need to travel to higher tier systems. The higher the tier of the pass the more they will expand the capacity, you can have up to 5 passes active in your vault. To use the pass simply put it in the vault and the capacity will be expanded.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/78743fc7c9d62b0ffd19d3c9599de8cf54fb0781.jpg

For those of you who need even more cargo space we have now added exterior cargo pods to space ships. Players can use these small vault like devices to easily store and transfer cargo. They come in two designs and 3 different sizes each, with corresponding capacity.
The cargo pod will allow easy access to these resources at a lower weight cost than a similar box capacity in a standard cargo bay.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/facaf843c22d1f9a653998cf83a49527979bd851.jpg

And last but not least! We have added 30 new exterior blocks for you to help design your ships the way you want to. Among these new blocks are a new and much requested feature, thinner solar panels! They generate the same amount of power as bigger ones however they should fit better with a more sleek slip design!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a5b7fc28775f7c1eec32daa46f2fcabcd56fdeec.jpg

Also, don't forget the ship design contest is still running for another week! Send in your design for a chance to have it become a new purchasable ship for Hurles Co.!

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join!

notes.title: Precious Cargo Space - interstellar Rift Development Update 137
notes.notes:
Time for another experimental patch! This week we’re pushing out the new limited vaults, cargo containers, and vault expansion passes.

From now on, the contents of the vault will be limited, this is in an effort to encourage players to create offsite storage facilities and shipyards for bigger ship construction.
Vaults will be limited to 500 crates by default, and can be expanded by simply placing a Vaultron expansion pass in your vault. Having these passes in your vault will permanently expand your vault capacity. You can have up to 5 passes active in your vault, and it will automatically select the highest tier passes first. You can buy the standard passes from the faction desk in the default tier systems, and from LogiCorp tool stores you come across in higher tier systems. 

And the second major feature are the new cargo containers. These containers can be attached to your hull and can be used for high capacity storage. Each container has an interface similar to that of the vault, and the interaction with them is essentially the same. The vaults come in various sizes from small to medium and large. And their capacity corresponds to their size starting at 40 crates, and going up to 100. 

During the experimental version of this patch we will be adding more cargo container shapes, and a whole set of new exterior blocks. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1739974199627070970/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift BETA 0.2.1.00
notes.notes:
FUNCTIONALITIES

- added warp firewall

	Can only be hacked when a ship is in warp
	When this firewall is down, the ship will drop out of warp and will generate a warp signature. The ship will also be unable to enter warp while this firewall is down.
	Can be repaired with repair cartridges
	Can be hacked from a distance that is 30 * the target's warp speed if the target's warp level is below 5
	If the target's warp level is 5 or above, the range is system wide

- added scanner signatures

	every ship and other important object can leave a scanner signature
	ships scan periodically for new signatures, this is sped up by enabling scanners, the duration of this is defined by the closeness
	when getting closer to a scanner signature, a bar displays over the icon, when the bar reaches zero, the signature updates it's location, allowing the user to get closer to it's true location
	ships generate a warp signature upon exiting warp. This signature is very precise but lasts only a couple of minutes.
	signatures are now the only way to find rich asteroids and gas clouds

- added station shield

	Resource Cost: 7500 Iron , 2500 Copper
	Creates a shield around the ship, rendering it invulnerable from any damage
	Can only be activated within a certains distance from the system's star (differs per system as the star's size differs. The termianl on the device shos when in range.)
	Upon activation, renders ship globally visible and a 15 minute timer will start to run
	15 minutes after activation, the station shield activates fully
	The shield is always visible and is able to be colored
	Power cost scales between 300 and 15000 power, depending on the mass of the station, capping at 1 million mass. 
	Requires one of 3 types of Focusing Crystal to be inserted to operate

- added 3 new tools

	Focusing Crystal TI

notes.title: Sight unseen - interstellar Rift Development Update 136
notes.notes:
Time for another update! This week we have the major sensor rework! The new cloaking device and the station shield! So without further delay let's get into the details...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3d6bd57710ef70621be5626d90eebbf90d56fda0.jpg

First up, the new sensor rework. From now on when you’re flying around the galaxy you will see occasional signatures pop up. These signatures can be several different kinds of phenomena. From a ship dropping out of warp, to rich asteroids, gas clouds and more.
These markers become more accurate the closer you are, so you will have to fly to them in order for them to give you a more accurate location. This goes for all sensor contacts.

Using this new system it will make exploration more interesting as well as add more difficulty in tracking down players for those of you living the space pirate life!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b91103ce8e87ad186beb905365cd0f9eb91d81d1.jpg

That said there is a nice way to counter being found using  sensors and that is the new cloaking device! The cloaking device will make it so nothing will show up on sensor contact until they are within 2 km of it. The cloaking device takes a while to fully enable and until it is fully on your ship will still leave a signature. Once it is fully enabled and it goes into deep cloak mode. It wont show up on sensor contacts anymore. You can’t kill what you cant find!
The cloak does have its limitations though, it doesn't function in warp and once you fire your weapons it will disable. This makes it a perfect tool for ambushing ships and hiding your large scale mining operations.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/304f0d47db2600bccbe8d292b4050f649068a322.jpg

And lastly there is the new station shield!
This device will let you generate an invulnerable station shield on a ship or station located near a star. It's important to note that the station shield will only function if the ship is in orbit around the sun. It takes a while to activate, and once it is activated the ship cannot move anymore.
You are however still able to use the station or ships weapons. Which is important considering once the shield is active it will make the location of the station known to everyone in the system.
The station shield uses special crystals that have a limited duration, and once they run out the station shield will have to be rebooted again. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a242dbaca0345f8a695ab33e38ee4e8ff1d76763.jpg

The station shield is intended for stations that players don't mind being found such as trade stations, or as a hub for your fleet or crew. 

We’ve also added in the new HydroPEX fuel tanker made by EternallySlaying that will make periodic stops in every system. Also we tried to contact you EternallySlaying, to ask how you want to be credited, so please let us know. 

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Stations Galore - interstellar Rift Development Update 134
notes.notes:
The experimental patch for this patch includes some new goodies that will make it easier and more secure for players to set up space stations.

The first device that we are adding is the new station shield. This device allows players to set up a space station near the sun with an invulnerability shield. This new shield requires a rare crystal (currently looking a lot like a heat sink, new graphic coming soon!) to power, and has a long start up time during which the players will need to defend it. Once the station shield is up, it will stay up until the resource depletes.

The second major addition in this patch is the cloaking device. This device hides your ship from sensors meaning it will be much more difficult to find. Unlike the station core this device requires an actual heat sink in order to operate. And it will function until the heat sink is depleted, or you use your weapons, warp, or disrupt the cloaking in any other way.

And lastly the new scanning system,

In order to combat the problem where players were able to find each other anywhere using the holo-table, we have now added a new scanning mechanic. When in the cockpit of your ship, you will now see signatures appear in space. These new signatures will lead you to points of interest or other players if you follow them. The closer you get, the more details they will display about their source. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

notes.title: Off the rail Weapons! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 132
notes.notes:
Welcome to the last Alpha patch before we head off to Beta early next week. This patch is a continuation of the combat patch and introduces more weapons, tweaks to enemies and more!

First off, let’s talk about the two new weapons! The tier 2 railgun and the flak cannon! These new weapons will add more variety to your arsenal! The railgun is a large weapon that fires inert tungsten projectiles at great speeds! Dealing a lot of damage to the target. That said the railgun has a slow fire rate and limited ammo capacity. As well as a charge up time before it can fire. To fire the railgun hold down the fire key and wait for the indicator to fill up, once its filled up you can fire the gun by releasing the fire key. If you hold down the fire key too long the gun will fire automatically and if  you don't hold it down long enough it wont fire at all.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/5295a685f742332777db281e2cfbe55cd38338a5.jpg

Additionally there is the flak cannon this weapon is meant as an area suppression weapon and fires multiple explosives per shot. Which detonate after a timer runs out, a collision with an object or if the distance of your current target has been traveled by the bullets. The explosions have a area damage effect so be sure to stay clear of them when you are under fire or if you intend to fly through them yourself.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7464d04832cd34ff6c153a2cb1b214685c5cef7b.jpg

Additionally we have rebalanced the Skrill as well as add new types of Skrill Grunts. These Grunts can now evolves when they eat certain gas clouds, and gain new abilities and strength! Skrill will evolve in a specific way, starting at normal these are the same enemies as you have known them in the past. Their next evolution will turn them green, granting them shields. Their next evolution will turn them blue and in addition to their shield, they gain more health, and they will arc lightning which can damage your shields and ship. And lastly they will turn red meaning they will have their previous upgrades plus more health and they will now also fire missiles. We plan to add similar evolutions to the other Skrill species as well. Note that in higher tier systems you may find these evolved Skrill naturally.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/8197b82ccdb053d244cb984ae416464eb26ce212.jpg

We’ve also been reworking how POIs (points of interest), are displayed on your flight hud. They are now grouped under the planets they are nearest to, and will split into different icons when you get close. We also added a new station list on the secondary monitor in the helm that allows you to target stations directly without searching for them in your hud first. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7fabca52ee027dc3eee956708d6812d053324b77.jpg

A change that is especially relevant for fans of larger ships, is that the amount of default armor your ship has now scales with the amount of hull blocks. You can get up to 1 large armor generator (100k armor) worth of extra hit points by placing more exterior blocks.  

For all other things in the patch, please see the details in the patch notes linked below. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a fairly busy discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you star-side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Blasting off to Beta - Interstellar Rift Development Update 130
notes.notes:
As you might have guessed from the title, Interstellar Rift will soon be moving to Beta. 

So, what does that mean for the you, the players? The move to Beta is mainly a change in our development schedule. We will no longer be adding features that require us to rework a lot of the code behind the scenes. Instead  we’ll focus on adding content to the existing features, polishing up things that have been added in the past, and adding features that work with the framework that we have been building.
It also marks a point where we can focus more on optimizing and stability. The repeated process of changing how large parts of how the game code works has continuously been breaking other parts of the game (as feature implementation tends to do). Which in turn would require us to fix those before moving on to new stuff. 
There will still be new additions to the game, both large and small. The main thing is that the underlying systems have been implemented, and won’t see any drastic changes anymore.   

Interstellar Rift is on sale right now, and will move to Beta shortly after the sale ends. As that happens there will also be a slight increase in the price. The game will go from € 14.99 to € 17.49, or your regional equivalent.  

Patches won’t change much, expect to still see a lot of tweaks to the game and new stuff being added. The next update for example will add in a couple of new weapons, rework the spawning and balance of Skrill, and make some changes to the default CPU and Armor values, scaling them a little with the size of your ship. 

Lastly we would like to thank everyone who tried the game over the last 4 years; from the people who play tested just the editor way back before the game even came to Steam, to those who joined us before combat was even a thing, and to the people who picked up the game in this week’s sale. Your feedback continues to be invaluable to the development of the game. 

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team 

If you have any questions, feel free to join our discord channel, we'll be more than happy to answer any of them. www.discord.gg/interstellarrift

notes.title: Guns Galore! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 129
notes.notes:
It's here! The long awaited weapons overhaul! This massive update brings with it a whole slew of new weapons, defensive options and balance changes!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mDqnjoR2xyg&feature=youtu.be
First up we have our new light arsenal. The way weapons work has been altered quite a bit.

Weapons now require CPU power. Which means players will now have to install a weapon CPU onboard their ships in order to make use of their weapons.

The weapon CPU determines how many offensive and defensive systems can be active at any given time, and thus also determines how many weapons can be fired at once. Players will need to consider whether they want to have more firepower or more defense. Weapons, shields, and the new armor generator among other devices, requires weapon CPU power. 
The new weapons we have added are all of the gimbal weapon variety. Which means they aim at where your mouse cursor is pointing while in the cockpit. This makes it so hitting fast moving targets is easier and should make combat a lot more fun and engaging. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/91ea0905a583b6642cd5ed8c3f5b8452e2e703b9.png

The new weapons we’ve added are the light autocannon, the light pulse laser and the light missile launcher.
The autocannon is similar to the old forward facing autocannon but it does less damage. It does however use the same ammunition. The light pulse laser fires a short laser beam. This weapon has no projectiles which means that it can hit what it is aiming at directly. And thus players will not need to lead the target. The pulse laser also does extra damage against shields. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/458e58376a7082120b4e7e41e64f75686b6b356e.png

And lastly the light missiles launcher fires small missiles in rapid succession which track the target. For this we’ve introduced the new missile locking mechanic. When the missiles are active when you hold on your mouse cursor over your currently selected target you will see a the missile lock indicator start to lock. Once missile lock has been acquired you will be able to fire the missiles. The torpedo launcher has also had this mechanic added.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/56edec7bb87c470d0384340a93912a3b07dc039a.png

One of the new devices we’ve added is the armor generator. These devices determine how many hitpoints your ship has. They also slowly repair your ship over time if you supply them with nanobots. The armor generator was added for balance reasons so that ships are no longer virtually immortal. They provide an upper limit to how many hit points any ship can have so that we are not balancing against infinity. We feel this will make combat much more engaging and fair.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/8ae1fca1eae8afddec2cdbafc542d0fefda03f3d.png

Lastly we have also added new countermeasures, the EMP generator allows you to disable missiles. Also if another ship is within an 800 meter radius the EMP will damage their shields and partially drain their batteries. Once fired the EMP needs to recharge for a bit before it can be fired again.

These are some of the changes and new things in this patch. For all the changes please see the patch notes. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have a discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

Patch Notes for IR Alpha 0.1.62

Feedback thread

IR Discord Channel

notes.title: A whole lot to process - Interstellar Rift Development Update 128
notes.notes:
Today we are introducing the first part the Interstellar Rift combat upgrade to the experimental branch. We are adding in two new weapons, the new CPU system, and the armor generator system.

First up in the editor you will see two new weapons that you can mount on your ships, the light autocannon and the light pulse laser, these two weapons work in a different manner from the weapons you are used to. They track the position of your cursor and fire in that direction. Meaning it should be easier to hit your targets. 
The autocannon fires projectiles similar to the old guns meaning the bullets have a travel time. And the lasers are hitscan, so they hit what they are aiming at when you press the button.

Additionally ships now require a CPU in order to operate equipment and weapons. So we added two new types of devices, a power CPU, and a weapons CPU. These control ship devices and weapons. Even though a ship in itself has a power CPU and weapon CPU, by default these are nowhere near as powerful as the additional CPUs you can install. For weapons only one CPU can be active at a time.

And lastly there is the armor generator. This new device determines the armor level of your ship and it needs to be equipped with the new nanobots resource. When the generator is equipped with nanobots it will slowly repair the armor overtime. Even when not equipped with nanobots the ship will still have armor so long as the device is active.

And lastly your ships hull has been downgraded to basically paper. It will offer very little protection once the armor has been destroyed, and can only tank 100 instances of damage.

These new progression systems will be iterated upon in the next few updates, so your feedback is very valuable, please let us know what you think!

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1741090666222995319/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

Which means in order to build these higher tier devices you need to get resources from these higher tier systems.

In order to get into these higher tier systems you will need to earn enough reputation so you can acquire new rift generator cartridges which allow you access to these systems. notes.title: A whole new universe! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 127
notes.notes:
This weeks experimental update brings with it quite a major change to the universe of interstellar Rift! Game progression has been cut up into separate tiers, or levels, that players will have to work towards in order to upgrade their ships and equipment.

Everyone will start at tier 0, using the equipment available at this tier players will be able to advance to tier one, two and finally three. Much like equipment is now divided into tiers, so are star systems! Meaning that each star system now has a corresponding tier level associated with it. In order to access these higher tier systems players will need to increase their reputation level with one of the four major factions, so that they will be able to purchase a tier appropriate navigation cartridge with which they can access these more dangerous star systems via the rift generator.

This also means that a lot of resources are now locked away per system, and the resource cost for a lot of devices has changed to accommodate this. Stores now only sell tier appropriate wares and missions only reference resources from their own tier. 

We are also experimenting with starting the stores empty, and have them be filled by drones and visiting stations. This is something we will be tweaking during the experimental phase of this update. 

All the starter stations now have a faction office where players can purchase basic items as well as faction navigation cartridges.

These new progression systems will be iterated upon in the next few updates, so your feedback is very valuable, please let us know what you think!

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1727575977526474415/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

notes.title: Gastronomical - Interstellar Rift Development Update 126
notes.notes:
Prime time! We’ve got another update for you! This time bringing in the the gas clouds and gas cloud harvesting!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yfnxa50kQlg
From now on you will encounter gas clouds which you can harvest using the new ramscoop device.
These gas resources are needed for the construction of high tier devices! Such as the large drone bay and the strip miner. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ce557dc3693aeee2ca2ebf9a3fa899d609ac7939.png

Gas clouds come in several varieties, and can be combined through the ram scoop into different colors which correspond to new types of even rarer materials. First you will need to gather these gases by using your ramscoop. Simply fly your ship into a gas cloud and check your ramscoop what types of gases can be harvested. Then you can turn on your ramscoop to gather them. If you wish to change the composition of the cloud you will need to gather the appropriate color and release it into a different gas cloud in order to get the composition that you need. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/216ac6428ccbdc3e73416fb709dc22977931b6f0.png

Gathering these new gases is not without its risks though. Blue gas clouds are electrically charged and will occasionally discharge their electricity to the nearest conductor. Which can be your ship or any other object in the cloud. Green clouds are acidic and will also start to eat away at your hull after a while. And red clouds are hot, and have random gas explosion. There is also a new heat system but those mechanics have not yet been implemented other than their visual component. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/d458609889f4e60d65840a03cf28d3cd76d35e16.png

Skrill however have decided that they no longer like the cold outskirts of systems, and now only spawn in regions of sufficient heat. This means that ships that exit a Rift will now end up far far away from the center of a system, instead of right next to the sun. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

notes.title: Fine dining - Interstellar Rift Development update 124
notes.notes:
It’s time to take the experimental patch out of the oven once again and serve it up! This weeks 3 course dinner consists of the new fine system, a new message system and the new drone system controllers.

For our appetizer we have the new message system. In your grip you will find that the icon for your mail center has changed a little, as it now displays the number of unread emails that you have. When going into the mail center itself you  will find its design has changed for the better. Each type of mail you receive will now be put into its own category. For example messages and fines have their own tab. This will make it much easier for  you to keep track of specific types of messages.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b83ddca63faa85b2316d0bd9fd33637e13df41d2.png

For the main course the new fine system. Whenever you violate the rules in a system in such a way that you receive a wanted level you will also be issued a fine. How high the fine is, depends on how serious the violation is. So the more damage you inflict the more you will have to pay. Each fine will have a time limit, before which you will need to pay to avoid further penalty. If you however do not pay it on time, you will find that Sentinel Security Systems will become quite hostile towards you until you pay your fine. Additionally, If your ship is destroyed by S3 the value of your ship and cargo will be used to pay for your fines. Your fines will be paid in the order that you receive them.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2423efe6b52a8164c564684286b9833f0ec4dae6.png

And for dessert we have the new drone system control device. This new device will be found on most stations and will determine the number of drones for each faction that can spawn.
So S3 stations will determine the number of security drones, HSC for mining drones and GT for trade drone etc. The drone controllers are admin models and cannot be placed by players.

Please note that to get these new drone controllers on every station older saves will have to do at least a partial rebuild. See the notes section in the patch notes below for more information on this. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

notes.title: Fines for days! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 123
notes.notes:
The experimental branch has been feeling a little neglected, so it's time for another patch. This time bringing with it Fines! The new Mail Center and Drone Control systems!

First up fines, whenever you commit a violation that will earn you a wanted star, you will now receive a fine. The severity of the crime and how much damage you inflict during that time will determine how heavy the fine is. The fine will show up in the new mail center along with an expiration date. Once the fine expires, Sentinel Security Systems drones will attack you on sight until the fine is paid. If however the S3 drones manage to destroy your ship, the value of your ship and its cargo will be deducted from all outstanding fines.

Next up the new mail center. When you get a new mail you will now see a red icon with the number of unread emails in them. Additionally the layout has been optimised to be easier to read, and categories have been added for each type of email.

And lastly the drone control systems, these new devices determine how many of each drone is allowed to be spawned in a system based on the station with the highest drone count in that system. So HSC stations determine the HSC mining drone count, S3 the S3 security drones etc. Constructing new stations in a system will open up new places for drones to spawn. Drone control systems are Admin Models, and server no purpose on player owned ships. They can be found on every station that has the ability to spawn drones, and can be used to see all the drones of that type and faction in the system, and what those drones are doing.

notes.title: Guide to the galaxy - Interstellar Rift Development Update 122
notes.notes:
Better check your insurance policies, because Vaultron is now accepting applications! 
The new vaultron insurance system will allow you to insure your ships in the unlikely case they are ever destroyed. 

You will find the new insurance system on the vaultron loan terminals. Here you will be able to select for which ship you would like to get insurance. The cost of insurance is calculated by adding up one 5th of the ship resource cost and the weight of the ship.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/b51e6aec570fce2f24119f2363320fccabf63ba5.jpg

When you apply insurance to a ship. It will be applied to that ship in the state it is in at the time of insuring. What that means is, if you modify your ship after applying the insurance those changes will not be insured. That means if your ship gets destroyed, you will be refunded the unmodified ship. In order receive your most up to date ship you will need to update your insurance. This can also be done through the same terminal by simply selecting your ship and you will be given the option to update your insurance.

Refunded ships will always be placed in the owner’s ship storage and can be retrieved at any Store-o-Tron kiosk.

Finally, we are adding a new player guide to the game. This new system will help new players learn about the game systems as they go. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/5b1187a38acd6af75c2fd38ce73afd0b94c9aba3.jpg

The new system will give players notifications regarding the ship, the devices on it, and more. The main intent for this system is to give new players a helping hand by explaining the game’s systems as they go. That said, the new system will also have some use for veteran players since it displays which systems are damaged. Or which fuel tanks are empty. And for those who do not wish to make use of this system, don't worry you can turn it off in the options menu.

For a full list of bug fixes please see the patch notes linked below.  
https://steamcommunity.com/games/363360/announcements/detail/2996459011306617895

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!

notes.title: Performance upgrades incoming! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 119
notes.notes:
This experimental patch is mainly under the hood changes that should improve performance considerably. 

This performance increase has been in development for a while and has been sorely needed. To go into a little more detail, we disconnected the lockstep gameplay state of the game from the client sided gameplay state. What that means is that walking around and flying around is decoupled from the heavy lifting that the game does in the background. Such as; calculating asteroid collisions, handling drone AI, and updating all the devices and thrusters on your ship. In short this should cause an increase in frame rate as the rendering should not be impacted as much by the ticking of the game world. There are also a number of crash and bug fixes included, and likely more to come as we monitor the game to look for potential issues of this update. 

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/2949168687328559629/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A new perspective - Interstellar Rift Development Update 118
notes.notes:
Time for another experimental patch to receive an upgrade to live status!
This week we’re adding a truckload of bug fixes, and some cool and long overdue features such as footstep sounds, a PVE mode, and more!

Starting off we have have added footstep sounds to both the male and female character which means you will now hear yourself and others around you walking. This should provide you with a slightly more immersive experience!

Next we have the PVE mode, this is a new server setting that can be toggled on and off by admins and server owners, or when creating a new galaxy. This mode will ensure  that other players cannot kill you or your ships. And only AI controlled enemies, or your own bad flying can hurt you and your ship. Using new options in the server browser, you can now filter servers based on what game mode they are.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/25bb438f5ef38dc28dd0dfbe759922c411b8c75d.png

And lastly we’ve made changes to the editor camera. You will find a new view mode toggle that will give you a flycam to use in the editor. This means the camera can move free of active level restrictions in the editor. This should make editing a ship’s hull much easier.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/d33e4e7639e6960c9f911808ed085620bbcd94f7.png

For a full list of bug fixes please see the patch notes linked below.  

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Don’t go down with your ship - Interstellar Rift Development Update 116
notes.notes:
Trading cards, escape pods, deathstates, oh my! The new next patch is ready for primetime! Introducing the ship deathstate, dropping your inventory on death, Steam Trading cards, Discord rich presence, and a lot more.

Ship deathstate, the escape pod and the dropping of the player inventory are closely tied together. And we had to make sure all 3 were done before we could implement any one of them  into the game. But it's all here now so Enjoy!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/cc1ea8b54d5bd416beec4a1ed9b0de9120665ea7.png

The Ship deathstate is there to give players a chance to grab their valuables and escape. But how do you escape a burning ship you ask? Why I’m glad you asked, because from now on you will be able to escape using the new escape pod! 
This new device can be placed on the side of your ship, and can be launched at any time! Once launched players will be able to fly to safety for a brief period. Escape pods can warp away quickly once launched. Additionally once you’ve gotten away you can salvage the escape pod for some resources that will help you get on your way again.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/82acf6401f3c1e1596f3e4954cb20a4604dfcf55.png

But since players now drop their inventory on death, players will now have more options to save themselves from the destruction of their ship. When you die a holographic projector droid is spawned on your position, containing all the stuff in your inventory, resources and tools. These little droids stay around for five minutes, after which they simply disappear.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/0cae5bfccf6766d1da2cb2847c94b6761756b0ea.png

The ship deathstate will last longer the bigger your ship is. Which means there will be an opportunity for the attackers to raid large ships once they have destroyed them.

But there is more as well. We’ve added in discord integration into the game. Which means you can now join your friends through discord and see what they are doing in their name tags.

And we’re also adding Steam trading cards to the game for you to collect and enjoy, these should be dropping as of posting this. 

For all the details on the changes we made, please see the link to the patch notes below. It will go into detail about the new escape pods, all the bug fixes, and some of the optimizations we’ve done this patch. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Abandon ship! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 115
notes.notes:
This weeks experimental patch brings some much needed goodies, such as the new ship death state, escape pods, player inventory drop on death, and Discord rich presence integration.

First up the new ship death state. When a ships hull reaches 0% health, the ship will no longer blow up instantly. The ship will enter a brief period in which it ceases to function, and random explosions will rock the ship. This is called the death state, during this period players will have the opportunity to gather what resources they want to save from their cargo hold, and use the escape pod to make a run for it.
Once the deathstate is over the ship will explode. And anyone onboard will be killed. Which now means that the inventories of those  players will be destroyed along with them. Hence why players will now need to use escape pods or other means of escape, if they wish to keep their inventories.

In addition if a player kills another player, a small device with the contents of their inventories will drop above their corpse allowing other players to loot their inventories, inventories will last for 5 minutes, after which they will despawn.

Escape pods will allow players to save themselves and their items from being lost when their ship gets destroyed. If a ship is equipped with an escape pod, players players will have a reliable way to escape a destroyed ship. Players can launch them by simply walking into them getting behind the controls and clicking the launch button. This will close the doors and teleport the pod away from the ship. Once launched players will have power to fly around for a brief period at maximum warp. The pod is not equipped with weapons and it is lightly armored so running away is your best option. Once you have reached safety, you will be able to salvage the escape pod for roughly 130k U-Nits worth of resources. The pod cannot be refueled once depleted. In addition pods can also be launched when the ship is in a death state, (a ship cannot move while in death state), and they can be replenished by purchasing them from HydroPEX service stations or Store-O-Tron kiosks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1700541698690075993/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: The Little Drone That Could - Interstellar Rift Development Update 114
notes.notes:
Time for another Interstellar Rift update! After simmering in the experimental branch for a little while, this new update featuring drone automation, and the new Medium Rift Generator, is ready for prime time.

The new Medium Rift Generator works very similarly to the small and large rift generator, but it is able to send ships through rifts with a mass rating up to 1 million. Meaning that it can only use regular Xanthium and Di-Xanthium. This is ideal for medium ships or small ships that wish to be able to use the same rift multiple times.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/309c3d152e706e549ad55a97c5a0274241d912b1.png

In addition we are also adding automation options to the heavy drones. This will allow you to put drones to work by sending them out to gather resources, return, automatically unload their goods, and then go out again. It also allows the drones to automatically respond if the ship is attacked. Meaning they will launch by themselves, and attack anything that is attacking the ship. 

Of course you will be able to cancel their commands, and retrieve them before their programming is up. The cartridges required for these automation functionalities can be made in the 3D Printer, or bought at stores that happen to sell them. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/be4b4d62da1bbab93c31601572c7c8c3186998e0.png

We’ve also made some changes to the point defense drones that players can deploy, from now on they require drone components, and when first created they will be empty. Meaning that players will now need to add ammo to the drone. Ammo can be added in the assembling machine, which also allows you to create drones that come with a full magazine by including the ammunition with the rest of the resources. For the time being point defense drones can only use standard ammo.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e44e5796127cbc4909428cacf1304d417f5ebd72.png

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 

Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

	Automation Cartridge: Drone Bay
	
		Can be inserted into drone bay
		Can contain up to 15 rules consisting of a condition and an action
		Drone rules are executed in order
		Available Conditions when docked:
			
				Resource Condition:

notes.title: Attack of the Drones - Interstellar Rift Development Update 112
notes.notes:
The long awaited Drone bay is finally here! Today the drone bay hits our live branch of Interstellar Rift, bringing with it the ability for players to construct and direct their own heavy drones. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q1dHtUVjVh8&feature=youtu.be
Once the bay is constructed aboard your ship, you will need special drone components to build the  drones (you’ll find the recipes in your grip’s encyclopedia and in the patch notes, as well as on the drone bay terminals.)
Your drones are fully customizable, you can change the color, their name and their load out from the control console on the second floor of the bay. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/f9a1e53b18d0162af5dcd11d6108d3b2620826d4.png

Drones can serve several purposes based on their load out. A drone with cargo pods attached can carry resources around and deliver them for example, and a drone with the engine attachment can fly much longer on the same amount of fuel. If you also equip that drone with a mining laser it can gather resources for you. Or if you’re looking for a more combat oriented version. You can equip the drone with missiles and two turrets. But unlike the drones that are activated via the disposer, these require fuel and ammunition. Which can be loaded into the drone using the resource hopper.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/71edac2161338e7a2ed0a866562119d73c347dfb.png

In addition there are also a bunch of improvements to the chat system, the cursor can now be moved, the chat commands for the console and ingame chat are now unified, and we added new commands, and updated the old ones where needed.

We’ve also made some changes to the underlying code which should result in performance gains on some systems. You should also see improvements to how you see other players. Which should mean less sliding around, more fluid animations, and a reduction in micro stuttering.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

	Made in Assembling Machine

Can be built in a drone bay

		Drone Body
			
			Cost - 12 Drone Parts: Construction, 4 Drone Parts: Flight, 4 Drone Parts: Electronics
			
		Drone Cargo Bay
			
			Cost - 6 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Electronics
			
		Missile Pods
			
			Cost - 2 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Electronics, 6 Drone Parts: Combat
			
		Engine Pods
			
			Cost - 4 Drone Parts: Construction, 2 Drone Parts: Flight, 1 Drone Parts: Electronics

BUG FIXES

notes.title: “Open the drone bay doors HAL” - Interstellar Rift Development Update 111
notes.notes:
It’s almost here, the much anticipated drone bay is hitting experimental today!

This means you will be able to build and configure your own heavy drones, and send them off into the galaxy to do your bidding. While on experimental it will still cost regular resources to build, but once it hits live there will be specialised drone components that you will have to craft in order to assemble a drone.

Over the next week or so we will be tweaking and making changes to the drone bay based on your feedback, so please feel free to let us know what you think. Please also note, that the drone bay is still a work in progress. So some graphical features and sounds might be missing, but will be added soon.

We’ve also made some changes to system event rewards and scout mission types, and we’ve made some major changes to the POI system under the hood. Which will make the system more efficient, and you should see a change in performance while piloting a ship.

Medium Fuel tank
	
	Can store up to 25000 fuel
	Building materials: 250 Iron + 75 Copper
	
Large Fuel tanks
	
	Can store up to 75000 fuel

Extra Large Fuel tank

- added Data Core Terminals to several stations

- server list now shows server version instead of IP

- server list now shows out of data servers as well, but at the bottom of the list and greyed out

- server list now shows Ping for the listed servers (using ICMP protocol)

- added version mismatch popup to Server List

- removed halloween models from main menu

- target indicator now changes it's position depending on how far away it's target is (should make guns a little more accurate)

BUG FIXES

- fixed bug where Vaultron Secure Payload mission would target the incorrect ship when another player goes to the ship where the resources should be delivered

- fixed missions showing up on the wrong dropbox

- added the -inline argument to attach the output and input to the parent process for dedicated servers

- removed several lockstep tick stalls (lag spikes)

- fixed an issue where the progress bar of the research cartridge would not update

- fixed an issue with the hacking terminal where it would change the connection with a ship when going through a rift

- fixed the descriptions of hydrogen tanks, now show the correct capacity

- fixed an issue where asteroids could go over their max size in the extractor

- fixed an issue with the color of the indicators of the new hydrogen tanks in the editor

- fixed teleporter UI showing the wrong color for some ships that were in a fleet, but not in your fleet

- fixed not being able to join a local server by clicking on the local server listing in the server browser

- fixed a bug where the turbines in the nuclear reactor would sometimes disappear

NOTES

- servers will need to be updated and restarted, no rebuilds required

notes.title: A sense of Purpose - Interstellar Rift Development Update 110
notes.notes:
This time around we’re introducing a couple of quality of life improvements such as a smaller rift generator and a series of new hydrogen fuel tanks. As well as a new cartridge progression system.

First up the new small rift generator will make it more convenient for players with small ships to get from system to system. However unlike its larger counterpart it can only use regular Xanthium which means that it will only be able to rift ships with a mass up to 100.000. In the near future we will also be adding a medium rift gen to service medium sized ships.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/c669b2f900c30798a643929db75a7a7f8dfea2be.png

We’re also adding 4 new hydrogen fuel tanks! All fuel tanks will now have an input hopper where you have to insert the fuel. Which means the placement and orientation of fuel tanks will now matter if you wish to refuel them manually. Refueling with the cargo teleporter still works as it always did. In addition we’ve added buttons to the fuel tanks where you can now choose to eject just one crate or fill your entire inventory. This should give you a bit more control over how you remove hydrogen from your tanks. The new tanks also visibly show which fuel is in the tank, and have an indicator that shows how full they are.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/47f5bf40a24b78ec828f03eeedf432cca6ddcc0c.png

And lastly the new cartridge progression system, you will now be able to buy or craft several new cartridges which can be used to advance your standing with a faction or be exchanged for units.
They come in the variety of starmap, faction or research cartridge. For more information, please click the link to the patch notes below. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/7ea1508252f7b8dd7e029b45ce5e82742c4f89d2.png

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Cartridge Bonanza - Interstellar Rift Development Update 109
notes.notes:
Experiment time! This week we are releasing a few quality of life devices, as well as a new discovery system. We are introducing the star map, research and faction data cartridge that can be used to advance your standing, or generate some U-nits for you.

In addition we are introducing a much needed new device known as the small rift generator, and it is exactly as advertised. A smaller version of the large rift generator that can only use regular Xanthium. Meaning that it will only be useful for ships that have a mass lower than 100.000 kilograms. We have plans for a medium rift generator later down the line as well.

We’re also adding two new sizes of fuel tank, while reworking the other two fuel tanks. All hydrogen fuel tank now have a resource hopper that you will have to insert the fuel into. 

Note that these are not all of the changes we are making for the upcoming patch, in the coming days we will be looking at your feedback and making changes based on that as well as adding more balancing tweaks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1480982971166121772/
Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: The event of a lifetime - Interstellar Rift Development Update 107
notes.notes:
After a longer period than usual we are happy to release patch 0.1.51 bringing with it system events.

These system events allow players of any skill level and progression to participate and help nudge a system to be controlled by their faction of choice. Players will be granted rewards for most objectives they participate in. So, for example, an objective is to help gather resources to build a station, every time they hand in resources they will be paid for it. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e9897fd8919b3f139dc2bc5b47a647d5cdc59bab.png

System events will be present in every non-starting system which now means that in some star systems there will be no space stations until some event objectives have been completed. Note that some stations do still spawn over time in some instances.

Once all the objectives for a given faction are completed that system will become owned by that faction. And players will be granted access to special rewards resources with which they can build more efficient fuel, ammunition and more. In the near future we will be adding ways for players to retake systems for other factions. As well as investigate the possibility of player factions.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/4c265730f99a43be522ef7d6247dfb45b4abe172.png

In addition we are also adding in skrill and drone bounties, regardless of where players destroy these threats players will be granted a small amount of money for their trouble. More difficult enemies will net higher bounties. We hope this will incentivise players to help keep their systems free of skrill. The skrill have also had their movement rebalanced so that they are more in line with the recent ship flight changes.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/dc9f57492f31bfaf8d67f9b515f1fc972348ae30.png

We’ve also added a new button to the GRIP, which will allow you to access the encyclopedia. In here you will be able to find the crafting recipes and a descriptions for every item, tool and resource in the game. This should eliminate any uncertainty as to what each item costs to make, or what it does.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Housecleaning part deux - Interstellar Rift Development Update 105
notes.notes:
This week we are doing some house cleaning, we have some quality of life changes and a bunch of bugfixes.

First up there is the event ticker, in the top right part of the screen you will find a new display that will tell you about what is happening around you and your ship. This will be useful during combat, as well during normal flight as it tells you the status of your own ship as well as your target.

In addition to the ticker, we also added the rift generator route planner, you can now search for systems that are out of range of your rift generator and it will direct you to the closest system en route to that system.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9a45c2bd0c2914e684b3a0abf6103e8ee283186d.png

Most of our efforts have gone into the upcoming Systemwide events, but we did include a bunch of bugfixes for some of the major issues that have been plaguing the game these past two weeks.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/18c4058b4e400ef9f65d56dfa86bfcc942f74e56.png

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: News from around the system! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 104
notes.notes:
In this experimental patch we're adding in some quality of life improvements and bug fixes, while we work on larger things behind the scenes.

While we're hard at work on the upcoming system events, this patch brings some smaller features that we've been meaning to add for some time. 

First up is a visual that helps you find the optimal route in the rift generator. Highlighting a path that you can follow from system to system when you search for one on the terminals. 

There is also a new UI element called the Event Ticker, that shows you things that happen to your ship and in your current system. It will notify you when you're out of fuel, for example, and when Eggnites have attached themselves to your ship. We are adding more events to the ticker over the coming weeks, which should help players get a better idea of the things that are happening in a system. 

There have also been balance tweaks, such as nerfing the damage Hunters do by a significant amount, and having shields drain only 25% of their normal power drain when fully charged. 

For all the details see the patch notes, where you can also leave feedback about this patch:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1496741765127170379/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A better way to fly - Interstellar Rift Development Update 103
notes.notes:
The much needed flight model overhaul is here!

We’ve spent some time to improve the way ships handle for an improved ship flight experience. Although our flight system uses a Newtonian physics system under the hood, a lot of it has been tweaked in favor of gameplay and ease of handling. 

So while not physically correct, what we always hoped to achieve was a balance between fun gameplay and interesting build options. What that means for this update, is that the flight model has been tweaked in such a way that the number of thrusters and the mass of your ship correlate. So hopefully it will be easier to tweak your handling experience in the ship editor.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ebfca20692ca31f0030ce7bf1887f809bc3c88f6.png

Speaking of the editor, we’ve now added several new features to the editor such as the new turn rate indicator that tells you what your turn rate is a gauge between 0 and 2 with 1 being what we would consider a good and easy to use turn rate. This gauge changes based on your ship's weight, and the number of thrusters.

To further improve the flight experience we’ve added a chase cam to the exterior view of the ship this should make ship flight feel easier and more natural when flying in exterior view. We’ve also added a slight amount of camera sway in the interior view.

We’ve also tweaked all of the starter ships to function properly with the new flight model and made the S3 starter ship a bit more durable for combat missions.

To help pilots out during warp, there is now a new indicator that shows you when your ship is experiencing heavy gravitational pull from nearby bodies that might drop your warp levels. Simply steer your ship away from the indicator and you should always be fine. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9786b85ae0d28f9717b254ff04eca7f6545525ec.png

Another addition to the ship editor is ship issues indicator. When you build your ship it will now have an indicator at the top of the screen that will tell you if your ship is missing certain devices to make it viable such as a life support system. Before this would only show up if you saved your ship.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/8baf3c7d9f4fe5cce7cf41548999b437657ed1bc.png

The other major feature is the addition of data cartridges which can give you special rewards such as new and unique armor skins. Theses skins will be tied to your Steam inventory and can be traded through Steam. In order to equip these armor skins you will need to enable them in the character customization menu and then when you equip a regular armor piece in game you will equip the armor piece with the attached skin instead.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/790138a4483e90d4f6f0b16764f631cc62d60fa6.png

In order to receive these items you will need to take a special cartridge which you can get from mission rewards or by looting them, and place them in a special data decoder which can be found the starting stations for each faction.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/137718d6f605a47166508c0eeabf880f729f5480.png

There's other changes in this patch, such as rebalanced power costs for a lot of devices, making non-warp flight much, much cheaper. New color palettes in the editor, optimizations, bug fixes and more! Please see the patch notes for full details. 

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join!
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Shipping and handling - Interstellar Rift Development Update 102
notes.notes:
This new experimental update brings with it a much needed overhaul of the ship flight model and a re-balance of ship systems.

Thrusters are now balanced based on ship weight. So heavy ships now need a lot of thrusters in order to turn while small ships need fewer. We've also taken a long hard look and changed the power consumption rates of a lot of devices in the game as well as their build costs and weight. This has the possibility that many of your ships will no longer function like you expect. And some ships such as purely solar powered ships will have trouble warping.

We’ve balanced ship flight more towards warp rather than regular flight so during normal flight your fuel is consumed at a lower rate than when you are warping. Warp is now much more costly in terms of power and increases based on your ship's weight.

In addition we are also adding a new loot mechanic which is tied in with the steam inventory. You can find new data cartridges in the world or you can receive them as mission rewards. On the starter stations you will find a new decoder terminal. Once you insert the data cartridge the decoder will analyse it and give you a random number of rewards. With a chance to receive a new armor piece skin.

These skins will be tied to your steam account and placed in your inventory they can be traded and sold in the steam marketplace just like any other steam item. 

The new armor skins can be applied to your character through the character customizations tab in the menu. Do note that you still need to build an armor set ingame and equip it before the new item shows on your character.

Note that these are not all of the changes we are making for the upcoming patch, in the coming days we will be looking at your feedback and making changes based on that as well as adding more balancing tweaks.

For full patch notes, and to leave feedback, see here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/1473095331510658047/

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Sales 101 - Interstellar Rift Development Update 101
notes.notes:
Starfaring entrepreneurs your time is now! With update 0.1.48 we are adding in player stores allowing you to set up your business empire to buy and sell goods!

To do this you will find the new player stores in the editor. Place these on a ship and you can set them to sell or buy any item or resource. You will need to assign cargo pads so your store will have a pad to place your bought items/resources, or where it takes the items from to sell. Each store unit comes with two stalls allowing you to sell two different items/resources per store unit. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2cd91ce4bb2e350f19c364339866a75ce2331a65.png

This patch also includes a number of new drones which have been added to the Sentinel Security Systems fleet, ready to engage anyone who commits an offense. First up we have the hacking drones, this drone will hack a random ship system when its in range. These will only spawn in systems with a S3 rating over 2000.
Next we have the Missile drone, these drones attack you with missiles. These will spawn in a system with an S3 rating above 3000.
And lastly we have the Interdictor drone, these drones will stop you going to warp while you are within range of them. These will only spawn in system with an S3 rating of 4000.
This about covers the new security drones. But there is one new drone variant which is not as law abiding. The pirate drone is a small scrappy looking drone which attacks everything. Except anything or anyone affiliated with the Drifters. 

We’ve also added in a new set of item lockers which accept all of the items. So unlike the wall locker and the weapons rack you can place everything with the exception of resources in here. They come in two varieties for now, a crate, and a more traditional locker that also includes two offset versions to allow more than one to be placed on a tile. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/67e1e82249eb9111e7459bfca2606a4ed374ca76.png

We’ve also made a few changes to the modify ship mode. When you delete a device from your ship and place it somewhere else. It will now remember what its status was before you deleted it. The same thing works when you load in a blueprint. It will try to keep as many devices with their current status intact even when placed in different locations.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better, please leave it here. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join here! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Sales 101 - Interstellar Rift Development Update 101
notes.notes:
Starfaring entrepreneurs your time is now! With update 0.1.48 we are adding in player stores allowing you to set up your business empire to buy and sell goods!

To do this you will find the new player stores in the editor. Place these on a ship and you can set them to sell or buy any item or resource. You will need to assign cargo pads so your store will have a pad to place your bought items/resources, or where it takes the items from to sell. Each store unit comes with two stalls allowing you to sell two different items/resources per store unit. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2cd91ce4bb2e350f19c364339866a75ce2331a65.png

This patch also includes a number of new drones which have been added to the Sentinel Security Systems fleet, ready to engage anyone who commits an offense. First up we have the hacking drones, this drone will hack a random ship system when its in range. These will only spawn in systems with a S3 rating over 2000.
Next we have the Missile drone, these drones attack you with missiles. These will spawn in a system with an S3 rating above 3000.
And lastly we have the Interdictor drone, these drones will stop you going to warp while you are within range of them. These will only spawn in system with an S3 rating of 4000.
This about covers the new security drones. But there is one new drone variant which is not as law abiding. The pirate drone is a small scrappy looking drone which attacks everything. Except anything or anyone affiliated with the Drifters. 

We’ve also added in a new set of item lockers which accept all of the items. So unlike the wall locker and the weapons rack you can place everything with the exception of resources in here. They come in two varieties for now, a crate, and a more traditional locker that also includes two offset versions to allow more than one to be placed on a tile. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/67e1e82249eb9111e7459bfca2606a4ed374ca76.png

We’ve also made a few changes to the modify ship mode. When you delete a device from your ship and place it somewhere else. It will now remember what its status was before you deleted it. The same thing works when you load in a blueprint. It will try to keep as many devices with their current status intact even when placed in different locations.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better, please leave it here. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join here! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team
