notes.title: Coming to a LogiStore near you! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 099
notes.notes:
Prime time! After a few nasty speed bumps we are ready to push this update to live! This week we are bringing rescue drones, the long awaited tool store and a series of much needed optimizations.

First off the tool store will now let you buy and sell items such as plasma pistols, ammunition, upgrade cartridges and more. These tool stores will be found on all of the starter stations with more stations to follow in the near future. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/1122b269ff50b86ad1b04b9dd1e55c7c33b5a0c8.png

Next we have the delivery drones. These little buggers can be summoned from the “Services” menu on the GRIP to bring you fuel and to repair your ship if you are in trouble. That said these services do not come cheap. You will be paying a premium sum of U-nits for the fuel and repairs. These drones should make it a little easier for new players learning the game to not get stranded. Note that rescue drones will first have to find the fuel and resources before they will travel to help you so it make take some time before they arrive.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a38ba7f0d033c63ef80a0b068b4569a4140a0242.png

And lastly, in the previous update we overhauled the space generation particularly when it came to asteroids, this caused the server save files to become massive and would result in very long loading times when using rifts to travel to other star systems. We’ve optimised this process and rift travel times should now be significantly less than they were before. In addition we’ve added a brief period of invulnerability to ships when leaving a rift so even if you exit the rift in the middle of a skrill swarm you will have about 30 seconds to react.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join here! 
Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A fashion statement - Interstellar Rift Development Update 097
notes.notes:
It's here! After a rather long period on the experimental branch the great big universe update is ready for prime time! Adding in character customization, a rework of the universe generation, and NPC drones which influence the in game economy! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/ad2265062b120ed07d5e52683fc4e7e8eb5e5e84.png

First up character customization! From now on you will be able to customize your character from the face, to the hair, bodysuit and the armor! You will be able to choose from several faces for both genders as well as hairstyles. And all can be completely customized with several color options for each. The armor items are craft-able in the 3D Printer, and can be placed in weapon racks. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/095fd87eb27a62b23dd87ad625acd22899ee28cc.png

We’ve also spend a significant amount of time in completely overhauling how space generation works, from now on, generated stations will be permanent they will not de-spawn and the types of stations that do spawn will be based on the faction influence in the star system. So the higher the influence of one faction in a solar system the more stations aligned with that faction will spawn. We are also working on a new system that will allow players to control what stations are in a system, and help construct new ones. Stay tuned for more on this system over the coming updates.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/26c2ca75502e707f608f97195cc454b9a2716bab.png

In addition asteroids will now spawn in gigantic belts around certain planets and around a star system. This means that you will no longer be able to park your ship in an asteroid belt and mine any resource indefinitely. Asteroids will deplete from your current location, but don't worry, there's no chance of running out of asteroids to mine! This means that it will take more effort to find rare resources. Players will need to use their sensors in order to prospect for the resources that they are looking for.

In addition, stations now no longer generate resources out of the blue, instead supply and demand is now met by cargo and mining drones which will mine the resources inside the star system and then supply space station stores with these resources. Stations equipped with a refinery will convert a percentage of these raw resources into refined resources. Then trade drones will ferry these resources between the other stations in the system based on the trade prices and demand of these stations. As a result players who enjoy trading resources will have compete with these drones.

In a future update these trade and mining drones will also interact with player owned stores resulting a more stable player driven economy.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. You can also join us on our public discord  here , feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion and feedback!


Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Whole new world! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 095
notes.notes:
Today we release one of the biggest change to universe generation in Interstellar Rift to date. On the experimental branch stations will be in permanent locations all of which are visible from the cockpit and the holo- table. These stations will spawn based on the faction influence in the system.

In addition Mining, trade and the general in game economy is going to have a major update! Asteroids now spawn in belts and planetary rings, and they do not re-spawn. Which means that you will no longer be able to sit in one spot to mine resources. In addition stations will no longer generate their own resources every hour, from now on each system is supplied by mining and trade drones. Mining drones will mine resources and trade drones buy resources from one station and sell it to another. This should cause some major changes to trade prices across the galaxy making resource trading more interesting across the board.

And last but not least, the first phase of character customization is here. You will now be able to set the colors of your characters suit as well as equip armor pieces to your character. In this first phase we will have just one set of armor but in the near future we will add several armor sets that you can mix and match with each other and each will have its own stats so that you can make your character exactly like you want!

Note that over the coming week we will be modifying spawn rates, and other values to make this new system more balanced and fun to play with.

A new experimental thread with patch notes can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/2592234299546140499/

Please leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Fiddling with automation - Interstellar Rift Development Update 094
notes.notes:
The second part of industry automation is now ready for prime time! This week we are introducing the Automated Cargo Teleportation Relay or A.C.T.R. for short. This device will allow you to automatically teleport cargo from one device to another. This will allow players to set up their own automated assembly lines!
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2857c4cc939f75c4c29d53529c3a1b8645ff00fa.png

ACTRs generate heat in a similar way to the nuclear reactor so in keeping with that the ACTRs require heatsinks in order to function properly. Using the ACTR players will be able to teleport items and cargo crates from one or multiple devices to one or multiple destinations. These devices can only teleport one resource at a time. So in order to set up a fully realised assembly line players will need to use multiple ACTRs combined with mining equipment refineries and production equipment.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e5e3c45dccb26c905e1b5a5b7686e4965c82cc94.png
 
As a balancing measure we’ve also changed the costs of heat sinks, since they are mainly used in more advanced equipment they now cost rarer resources and more of them. Since the heat sinks are also used by the nuclear reactor this will also be a slight nerf to the nuclear reactor as you will require more resources to build the heat sinks for them.
 
Today we are also releasing the Interstellar Rift soundtrack, composed by Curtis Schweitzer and produced by The Otherworld Agency! Enjoy!
 
You can buy the soundtrack now! Right here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/648690/Interstellar_Rift__Official_Sound_Track/ 
As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better. We have also set up a public discord server which you can join here! Feel free to drop by and have a chat, we’d love to hear your opinion.
 
Thank you all for playing and see you starside!
 
-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Droning on! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 092
notes.notes:
Update time! This week we are pushing the new Sentinel Security Systems security drones into the live servers! 

These new drones will be patrolling all faction stations except those of the drifters. The security drones will from now on be enforcing the no fire zones, which means that your weapons will no longer be locked when you are near one of the starter stations. Which brings us to the wanted level, when a player violates a no fire zone, attacks a protected station or player the player will receive a wanted level which determines how the security drones will respond to you. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/cc8abc2fb161f97e28c2fb9c7740d2585a36b378.png

Your wanted level ranges from 0 stars to 5 stars and will decay slowly over time. If you fight back against the security drones your wanted level will increase, however if you stop attacking or damaging the drones your wanted level will decrease. When you’re at max wanted level it will take roughly 5 minutes to completely decay. Oh and these drones can chase you through warp so good luck :)
 
The security drones can also be hired to protect your ships and stations, on the major faction stations you will find a new sentinel security systems service desk manned by Keith the droid.
Here you can hire a up to 9 drones to come and protect you for up to 72 hours for a nominal fee.

When you are attacked these drones will warp in and destroy any threat that was made against you.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9f42315b4e3821dd038a7df6e8ccbae0a3e5239b.png
 
In addition we have fired a new volley in the fight against desyncs. While it is not a true fix but more a stopgap to prevent major issues which result from desyncs. The game will now automatically reconnect you when you’re desyncing, however this should not take nearly as long as when you’re connecting to a server normally. And when the entire server is desyncing and a reconnect doesn't fix it. It will automatically reload the server save and reconnect everyone.
 
As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better.
 
Thank you all for playing and see you starside!
 
-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Protection racket! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 091
notes.notes:
Experiment time! This time we are introducing new protection combat drones that will be patrolling starter stations. 

This means that the no fire zone around the starter stations will no longer prevent you from shooting, however it does mean that if you violate the no fire zone by firing inside of it, you will be met with a response in kind from the local defense drones. If there are no drones in the local area they will warp in from around the system, and they can chase anyone who warps away by entering warp themselves. 

Additionally the drones can also be hired by players to protect their ships for a limited time. However this protection doesn't come cheap. You can acquire this temporary protected status by going to one of the new S3 Ship protection service desks found in most major stations.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better. A new experimental thread can be found here:

notes.title: Captains of Industry! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 090
notes.notes:
Today we introduce the first section of industry automation! With this update the extractor, refinery, salvager, 3d printer, and the assembling machine will all have a new cartridge slot which can be found at their control console. Players will be able to insert an automation cartridge into these machines which will let them function autonomously until the cartridge is expended.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e60f0480dc773ef3b721570c81a9a246055fcab0.png

These cartridges can be crafted in the 3d printer. Automation cartridges work in a similar way to the upgrade cartridges in that they decay after a period of time, in this case 12 hours. Once they are completely spent players will have to replace them. 

These cartridges come in 3 types:
Processing cartridges - these are meant to be used with the assembler and refinery
Extraction cartridges - These are meant to be used with the salvager and the regular resource extractor (strip miner also has a built in automation function and does not need a cartridge)
Printing cartridges - This one is meant to be used with the 3d printer.

Note that these devices will stop their function if their hopper is full. Therefore in order to keep these devices functioning at peak efficiency players will have to keep up and clear the exit hoppers whenever necessary.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/c5ea6d15b40c98f6978ce1f37724f4f155b3589d.png 

The next part of industry automation will focus on moving cargo from one device to another or onto cargo pads.  This will be done through new devices called the Automated Cargo Teleportation Relays (ACTR). This device will use two heatsinks and can be programmed to move a cargo crate from one device to another automatically. Combined with the automation cartridges players will be able to set up their own assembly lines for whatever materials and items they require.
This part of automation will be coming soon.

In addition we have also made several quality of life changes. Hydrogen fuel is now 4 times more efficient and thus will last 4 times longer. The salvager has had its range increased to 1000 meters which should make salvaging easier. We’ve also added in some more diagnostic tools that should make it easier for us to find desyncs!

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide, it will only help us make the game better.

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: A Galaxy Divided - Interstellar Rift Development Update 088
notes.notes:
Time for another Interstellar Rift update! This week we split up the starting factions into their own star systems. This way we make it easier for each faction to develop more of an identity, and we hope to localize the players that have similar play styles. This change comes with a new Hurles Co. starting station, a new GT mining station, and a “new” S3 mining station that might look familiar. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3912447a901994d2b4d5658244493894012ca30d.png

Next up we have rebuilt the wallet system and have split your wallet balance into two separate pools. From now on you have a wallet balance and a debt. The wallet balance tells you exactly how much money you have available to spent. And the debt indicates how much debt you have. A debt must be repaid, and you can repay this in two ways. You can either pay it directly at a new Vaultron loan terminal (available at every starter station). Additionally every time you complete a mission or when you sell something to a store a percentage of your reward will be paid to your debt. This percentage increases when you have more debt and lowers as you reduce your debt until your debt is fully repaid. At which point you will receive 100% of U-nit rewards. The debt percentage cannot exceed 50%. It is no longer possible to have a negative balance in your wallet, which means that you will always have cash to spend, separate from your debt

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/cd7e3e29cea3e81443883f54b429236a9c79554e.png

In addition to the debt system we have also implemented a loan system. If you are in need of some extra cash you can take out one of three loans at a Vaultron loan terminal. Each loan will will come with a set interest percentage. The loans have a timer so you won’t be able take more than 3 at once. Loans are paid off like normal debt, either at a terminal, and as a percentage of each transaction you make.

We’ve also added in the ability to swap your primary faction. This way you can change your starter station. On every starter station you will find the new recruiter droid. When you approach the droid it will present you with a screen on which you can choose to join that station’s faction. Note that changing your primary faction will not reset your faction reputation. And factions with which you are unfriendly will not allow you to join. Also if you lose enough faction reputation you will be kicked out and receive an email telling you so. At this point you will automatically join the drifters and thus the black pit will be your respawn point.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/02e517a9772d25f094b5823404b1b43a0b5bbd23.png

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better.

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Shining a new light on the galaxy - Interstellar Rift Development Update 086
notes.notes:
This week’s update will add the ability for co-op crew missions. With this new feature you can share some mission rewards automatically with anyone in your crew. Players in your crew will also see objective markers.

In addition we’ve also introduced the ability to give other players items and resources. If you look at another player you can press “E” and give them the item you currently have equipped. This should make it a little easier to work together with players and share stuff like repair guns, ammo and more. You are also able to give other players mission critical items so that missions can be completed by other players.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/4020d45e026d3bee3a0ca871af99068bdb22ea06.png

Additionally, a new Skrill has awakened. It is called the Disruptor. The new Skrill can deploy a warp disruption field. Which will prevent ships caught within from warping away until they leave it’s radius or kill the Disruptor. Be careful though because the Disruptor is seldom seen alone. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/baee4375b937cb10b55d600bc2750b2bab8deac8.png

We’ve also added the first iteration for random events into the game. This update will bring the Asteroid Storm event. You might see hundreds of asteroids fly by around your ship and some of them might impact your ship, causing a little damage.

We’ve also made some changes to the space around your ship. For instance, some planets will now have rings. And the sun will now actually illuminate the objects in space. There have also been some changes to the shield visual effects. The shield is now only shown when it is hit by objects or projectiles.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/647a2c81c744a0c25b8a9292697769cc34e722c6.png

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better.

NOTE:
Rebuilding old saves is necessary, to do this in single player, press F8 and under rebuild select the third rebuild option. To do this on servers either join the server as the admin and do the same, or in the console type "rebuildServer 2" to start rebuilding

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.notes:
FUNCTIONALITIES

- Added new Strip Miner device. 

Can be found in room edit mode > Systems
Costs 12,500 Steel, 25,000 Iron, 7,500 Aluminium
Has a mass of 250,000
Has 4 arms that can mine different resources from the same asteroid
Has a range of 1500m

- added new, bigger asteroids that can be mined with the Strip Miner

- the options menu can now be called from within the game via the Escape Menu

- Gravitational Anchor now takes rotation into account

- when an object is targeted while you are in warp, an arrow indicator will show when it is recommended to change warp level, along with an estimated time of arrival at current warp level

- password text field can now be confirmed with enter and text field is automatically activated upon popup activation

- scanners can now be toggled on and off in scanner gui

- scanners are now disabled by default

- added a new wall set, includes wall, airvent, window and wall light

- increased ship mode holotable max range to 32km from 16km

- asteroid fields now spawn fully filled with asteroids

- HSC excavator now has scanners disabled by default so it doesn't burn hydrogen for no reason

- rebalanced S3 Peregrine power so it is less confusing for newer players. Weapons now use power from an engine instead of battery + solar panels.

- increased missile speed to make missiles a little more viable against aliens

- implemented delete button for languages (deleting a language also unsubscribes you from the workshop item)

notes.title: Stripping asteroids - Interstellar Rift Development Update 084
notes.notes:
Patch 1.40 is now live. Be sure to be on the lookout for the new rich asteroids when exploring space. If you run into one, scan it using the revamped scanners menu from your helm, if you have sensors installed on your ship. You might find it contains a whole lot of precious resources.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/d0e124c3fcc753c8848f87b0bb07b0990b4cfda4.png

The Extractor you are used to however, is not qualified to mine these huge pieces of rock. In order to gain access to the riches and wealth contained within, you will need to set up your own mining station on the spot, featuring the brand new Strip Miner.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/503267b19d843cef1b1c5440a4ea0a3d5ea75233.png

 This enormous new device uses a mining laser to cut parts of the asteroid which are sucked into the ship, where four arms extract resources out of it. You can choose what ore you want each arm to focus on and they can store up to 100000 units of ore. It might not be the fastest way of mining, but as long as there is at least one person in the system, the stripminer will go along doing its business so there is no need to wait around. Just get back to your ship and explore the galaxy while you leave the boring repetitive tasks to the machine. Come back later to a warm home filled with minerals you need to build that enormous warship you wanted for so long.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3db4ee0501c2715d21be7a7727742270f9f4b00e.png

Speaking of exploring the galaxy, the new warp assist should make it easier than ever to get somewhere. Simply target the place you want to go (by default the T button), jump to warp and some handy arrows should tell you when to throttle up or down.

I’ll round up this post with a quick shout out to the new props introduced in this patch. This pack includes similarly themed wall, wall light, wall fan, and window you can use to give a fresh look to your ships.

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you star side!

notes.title: Drilling deeper - Interstellar Rift Development Update 083
notes.notes:
New features are ready to be tested on the experimental branch. This patch includes a small rework for the scanner system, some assistance to get the perfect warp level, a couple of new props, and an alternative to traditional mining: the strip miner.

The strip miner is a very large and heavy device designed to be placed on stations in order to mine specific very large and resource rich asteroids. Be on the lookout for the new HUD icon when exploring space to find out which asteroids can be mined. The strip miner mines a lot slower compared to the extractor, but it can buffer a large amount of mined resources and multiple resource types at once. It will continue mining as long as there is at least one person in the system, so feel free to do something else after you turned it on and come back later to a station filled with precious loot.

In order to find the perfect asteroid effectively, the scanners have received some updates. First of all the scanners menu will now feature an on/off button so the scanners are no longer draining power when you are not using them. This menu has also received somewhat of a graphical overhaul in order to make it more readable and more pleasant to use.

Finding the perfect warp level can be somewhat of a pain, but some updates to the ship flight GUI should make this task a lot easier. Once a target is selected (by default by pressing T for those who didn’t know) the HUD will show an arrow indicating whether throttling up or down is a good idea. It should also show the time it takes to reach the destination at the current speed.

Finally, there are some new props for the interior designers among you. These include: 

A new wall,
A new wall light
A new window
A new wall fan


Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you star side!

notes.title: Death, a minor inconvenience - Interstellar Rift Development Update 082
notes.notes:
After a brief incubation in the experimental oven, we feel this patch is ready for prime time! 
First on the list is the new Skrill stinger, this agile Skrill creature can't wait to give you a hug upon which it will explode with joy! This new enemy can be found star systems with a Skrill rating of 2000 and higher.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/1fa26d393e1f072f8cf94ffd41de24dc81dafc79.png

We’ve also taken the time to revamp several of the game’s menus. Primarily the server browser and the respawn menu. The server browser now allows you to sort servers based on name, player count, and on another new feature, password protected servers. You are now able to set a password for your server so you and your friends can play without fear of having to deal with uninvited guests. You can set your passwords from the in-game menu or from the server config file. 

The respawn menu has also had a major overhaul. Plus respawn costs have been added based on the distance of the target ship. This is to provide more of a penalty for dying and respawning. 
You will now also see a list of nearby available ships when respawning, you can always respawn on friendly ships within a range of 100 kilometers, the Black Pit, or your starter station. After respawning on a ship in the same system that is more than a 100 kilometers from your grave, you will have to wait 15 minutes before being able to do this again. The Black Pit and your starter station will always be available though. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/fcf2f867092249cf68ead90d1812d0665057162c.png

We’ve also taken the time to add the ability to turn lights on and off. Simply look at any light in the game and press e when prompted to turn it off. We will soon be adding in the ability to turn off lights per room.

This update also includes a healthy dose of bug fixes, and server optimizations, as this is where our primary focus is at the moment. 

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you star side!

notes.title: Kaboom! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 081
notes.notes:
Time for another Interstellar Rift experimental update. We’ve made some quality of life improvements as well as introduced a new enemy that will be coming after you and your little ships.

We have revamped the death menu and fixed the functionality for respawn on nearby ship. When you click on respawn on nearby ship you will get a list of all ships that are available. Dying now also has a cost attached to it, as well as a timer on respawning on nearby friendly ships. 

In addition we have also made it possible to turn lights on and off by looking at the light and pressing the use button (E by default). We are working on a general controller that will let you turn lights on and off in an entire room.

We’re also introducing the skrill Stinger. These smaller skrill can often be found roaming among larger groups of skrill and in asteroid fields. These creatures, once they have found you, will chase you and explode on impact. Fortunately they will not take a lot of damage to kill but their speed will make them somewhat tricky to hit. Especially in greater numbers.

As you may have noticed our war on desyncs is ever ongoing and this patch also includes more fixes that should make desyncing less likely.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better. A new experimental thread can be found here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/135510393201357493/

Please leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.38
notes.notes:
FUNCTIONALITIES

- added new resources
		
		Raw Resources
			
			 Lead Ore (can spawn in every system)
			 Aluminium Ore (can spawn in every system)
			 Uranium Ore (25% chance to spawn in systems with a Skrill rating of 3000 and above)
			

		Refined Resources
			
			 Lead (Created from Lead Ore in Refinery)
			 Aluminium (Created from Aluminium Ore in Refinery)
			 Uranium (Created from Uranium Ore in Refinery)
			

		Turbines
			
			 Iron Turbine (Created in Assembling machine, costs 1200 Iron)
			 Steel turbine (Created in Assembling machine, costs 900 steel)
			 Platinum turbine (Created in Assembling machine, costs 600 Iron + 100 Platinum)
			
			
		Reactor Fuel Cells
			
			 Uranium-238 Fuel Cell (Created in Assembling machine, costs: 300 uranium + 150 Iron + 75 Steel + 75 Silicon)
			 Plutonium-239 Fuel Cell (Created in Assembling machine, costs: 4 Depleted Uranium-238 Fuel Cells)
			 Plutonium-241 Fuel Cell (Created in Assembling machine, costs: 4 Depleted Plutonium-239 Fuel Cells)
			

		Depleted Reactor Fuel Cells
		
			 Uranium-238D Fuel Cell (Created in Nuclear Reactor)
			 Plutonium-239D Fuel Cell (Created in Nuclear Reactor)
			 Plutonium-241D Fuel Cell (Created in Nuclear Reactor)
			
		
- added new items
		
		 Heatsink TI (cost: 50 Aluminium, 5 Deuterium)
		 Heatsink TII (cost: 50 Copper, 5 Deuterium)
		 Heatsink TIII (cost: 25 Aluminium, 25 Beryllium, 5 Deuterium)
		
- added Nuclear Reactor
		
		 cost: 1200 Steel, 1250 Lead, 500 Copper, 500 Silicon, 1500 Aluminium
		 generates power based on core heat
		
				
		 up to 4 fuel cells can be inserted
		 fuel cells cannot be removed unless depleted
		 each inserted fuel cell will generate heat (100K, 200K and 500K respectively)
		
		
		 up to 2 Turbines can be inserted
		 reactor will only output power if at least one generator is inserted
		
		
		 up to 8 heat sinks can be inserted
		 heat sinks will increase max safe temperature of reactor core (50K, 100K, 250K respectively)
		 reactor will start taking damage if temperature is above max safe temperature
		
		
		 will explode and damage all devices in the same room if device health reaches 0
		 explosion will kill all players in the room
					
- added new large engine
		
		 thrust: 950K
		 rotational thrust: 500K
		 power usage: 5000/tick
		 mass: 7200
		 costs: 5250 Steel, 2500 Aluminium, 1500 Copper, 1500 Silicon
				
- added sub-process saving [EXPERIMENTAL]
		
		 nearly eliminates player join and save lag spike
		 is disabled by default while on experimental (will be turned on on the experimental test server)
		 can be turned on in the options menu (or setting "CreateGhostClients" to true)
		 will use more CPU on larger saves
		 will create an additional process per active star system
		 these processes do not create console windows, but they can be toggled on by setting "GhostClientConsoleVisible" to true
		
- added listplayers command to server console (lists all currently online players and their Steam Id's)		

BUG FIXES

- re-added Mouse Invert Y axis option

- fixed ship exterior twitching during warp

- when upgrading a ship, its health % will be kept constant

- missions will now regenerate after a delay

- dead players are now properly removed from cockpits

- fixed clicking through respawn UI

- systemstats are now reloaded per generated system when rebuilding rules

- when rebuild world is called and a station is using an old position, it no longer triggers secondary rules like turrets or asteroid fields

NOTES

- server/client saves will need to be rebuilt using the second rebuild option. This option can be found in the Admin menu (F8).

notes.title: Carpe Nuke’m - Interstellar Rift Development Update 080
notes.notes:
Nuclear power is here! This patch introduces the nuclear fission reactor to Interstellar Rift! Finally you will be able to power your large ships with a more efficient fuel source. 

Nuclear power however is not without risks. The reactor operates on three resources, The first of which are fuel rods which come in three variants, Uranium 238, Plutonium 239, and finally Plutonium 241. These are ranked from least to most powerful. Once a fuel rod is depleted, the fuel rod in the slot will become a depleted fuel rod marked by the D after the type number, also the fuel rods core will be empty. These depleted fuel rods can be used to craft the next tier of fuel rods. However you will need 4 depleted fuel rods to craft one of the next tier.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/e82d4a6172f9a0de13286e38d8d072f5196e304c.png
The second type of resource are heat sinks, these items need to be inserted in the small slots on the side of the reactor. The heatsinks keep the reactor from overheating. But like the fuel rods they come in 3 different tiers, each tier is capable of handling a higher heat output, and has a longer durability. Once the reactors heat output exceeds that what your combined total of heatsinks can handle the reactor will start to take damage.

The third and final resource required to run the nuclear reactor are the turbines, just like the other two these come in three varieties, Iron, Steel and Platinum turbines. The turbines are required to generate power. If you activate the generator without turbines it will consume fuel and generate heat but it won’t generate any power. Each tier of turbine will last longer and generate more power.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/cd0b374d99bfbe2f2cf518b3efcab692c0d269e9.png
You can configure the nuclear reactor to suit your ships needs while still keeping it economical. But at it’s absolute maximum output the generator will output around 30k of power.

In addition to the nuclear reactor we have also included the new Tech 3 Engine, This new engine is designed to be used with a nuclear reactor as it needs a lot of power and will be rather inefficient when used with hydrogen generators. The T3 engine is designed for large ships, not so much for smaller ones. And the engine will cap out at around 800 m/s

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a03b01ac482a3c0a6ea5848409d59c41883a9082.png
Also in this patch, two new construction resources, Aluminium and Lead, both used for the new reactor. Aluminium and Lead are quite common and can be found in most systems. Another new resource however, Uranium, can only be found in systems with a Skrill rating of over 3000. 

Aluminium, Lead, and their ores can be bought in most shops. Uranium can only be bought as a refined resource and is one of the most expensive resources in the game. Fuel cells can not be bought anywhere, though you may find depleted ones on ships belonging to the Drifters. 

Big changes have been made to the underlying systems of Interstellar Rift, in relation to saving and joining a multiplayer game. These changes are live in this branch and you can enable them for your single player games via the options menu.

For multiplayer servers however, you will need to set a flag in the server.json file in your Interstellar Rift appdata folder to true. This flag is called: "CreateGhostClients", if you also want to keep track of all the ghost clients that are made, enable the next line as well; "GhostClientConsoleVisible." This will show a console window for every running ghost client. These clients will do the heavy lifting of the save and load function of Interstellar Rift in the background, mostly eliminating any ingame hiccups. They are still a work in progress though and might negatively impact performance. Our own server will be running with these turned on, but you might have to check for yourself if you find them to be optimal for your gaming experience.

As always,we hope you’ll enjoy this update! and we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide as it will only help us make the game better. See you Starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: An experiment in nuclear fission - Interstellar Rift Development Update 079
notes.notes:
It is time for for Interstellar Rift to enter the nuclear age. Up until now you  had to power your vessels using clean hydrogen and solar power. While this power source is fine for smaller ships, some of you have a tendency to go a bit beyond the scope of what is possible and efficient.

Introducing the nuclear reactor!

this massive new device will output much more power and require comparatively less fuel over a longer period of time. That said it is a device that requires maintenance. The reactor requires multiple resources in order to function such as heat sinks, turbines, and reactor fuel in the form of uranium or plutonium.

But wait there is more! In addition to the nuclear reactor we also have added the Tech 3 engine. This massive engine is designed to function with the Nuclear reactor and propel ships carrying a nuclear reactor. The T3 engine is capable of being powered by regular power sources but it will require a lot of hydrogen generators and fuel.

To support the nuclear reactor we have added a grand total of 18 new resources. Including lead, uranium, plutonium, aluminium and several others that are unique for the reactor.

This patch will be applied to the default branch of the game as soon as we are happy with the new balance changes, and eliminate any bugs that might be found over the next couple of days.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better. For the full patch notes see here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/135507855755580784/

Please leave your feedback about this patch here, or in the patch notes thread.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you star side!


-The Split Polygon Team

The first official patch for 2017 is here!

So after a short while on the experimental branch we feel patch 0.1.37 is ready for prime time. Over the past few days we’ve already seen a very positive response, and great feedback, to the new translation tool. And we appreciate those of you who have already taken the time to translate part, or the whole game to your native languages. We will have some community reward tokens in the near future for those who help out the game in significant ways, including translations.You can only find these new translation files on the steam workshop for now, but we are working to make them available from an ingame menu as well. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/f55bb68c6f3569bcc3ff15cbb5049f18502d1ce8.png

For more information about translations, and how to upload one yourself, click here.

This patch will also make the new cargo missions available to everyone. Players will find these cargo missions only at GT trade stations. We will add them to the other factions as well at a later date. With this new mission we also introduced the ability to teleport cargo directly from your ship to the mission dropbox on the target station. Note that is currently only possible with the large cargo missions. Missions that require only a few crates will still require you to teleport over to the station and hand them in manually. Note we will be adding this functionally to the rest of the missions at a later date.

Skrill are now smarter as they try to dodge bullets, fly in more unpredictable patterns and attempt to ram your ship. Skrill hunters have also become more deadly as they now try to match speed with the ship they are attacking and make attack runs. Additionally we have also removed the behaviour where Skrill would not attack ships above a certain weight class. Skrill should now attack you regardless of what ship you are currently in. This should make going into Skrill infested star systems much more challenging and fun.

We’ve also spend some time on fixing up the options menu to be more in line with the industry standard. These enhancements will soon be making their way into an in game options menu as well, removing the need to go back to the main menu to make simple control tweaks.

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide as it will only help us make the game better. We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you star side!

notes.title: A New Year's Experiment! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 077
notes.notes:
First of all happy new year! We hope everyone has had a wonderful holiday season!

To kick off 2017 we’re putting up patch e0.1.37 on the experimental branch! This patch introduces the new translation tool. Over the past few months we’ve had a lot of offers from people to help translate the game into new languages. So in order to facilitate this we’ve made a simple to use translation tool which will allow you to share your translation file via the Steam Workshop!

There is also a new cargo mission which specifically requires ships with a very large cargo hold. Appropriate rewards and penalties are associated with these missions. For these missions you will also be able to use the cargo teleporter to teleport your mission resources directly into the station's mission dropbox. So you won't have to constantly teleport to and from the station yourself in order to hand in the mission.

We’ve also done some work on the Skrill AI and made them a bit more challenging to fight! They will now orbit your ship, ram your ship, and do bombing runs. Both the hunter and the skrill grunt will have these changes although they will have different behaviour. And we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide. We have also tweaked the Skrill to be a bit more menacing, and we’ve been hard at work with creating new Skrill with different behaviour sets and abilities. Expect to see these in the game over the coming months.  

And lastly we’ve overhauled the options menu to be a bit more user friendly. This is part of a total overhaul that will be applied to all the menus in the start screen of the game. We will also be introducing a way to change most of these settings from the ingame menu soon!

As always, we’d appreciate any feedback you’re willing to provide it will only help us make the game better. A new experimental thread with the patch notes can be found here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/144513248276908464/

Please leave your feedback about this patch there.

Instructions on how to join the experimental branch can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/350542145693906320/

Thank you all for playing and see you starside!

-The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Merriment to all - Interstellar Rift Development Update 076

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.36
notes.notes:
FUNCTIONALITIES

- repair gun now differentiates between devices and eggnites when aimed at one. eggnites are red, devices are blue

- repair gun now does not work when out of range 

- repair gun repair beam does not show when out of ammo

- rift generator now selects a system when using the search bar

- added reward overview to the final message of a mission

- added a new, fast paced mission with a short timer for GT

- added a new Logicorp wing to GT Trade Hub, containing 3D printers

- added a new, scripted tutorial

- added new mission log. can be toggled with [L] by default, objectives can be expanded by holding down [L ALT] and clicking on the objective

- added new mission description pop-up. can be closed by pressing [Delete] by default

- blueprints from the workshop are now listed with a steam logo in front of them on the ship editor terminal

- new markers for quests, now also display the distance to the objective on a ship or station

- missions now show a counter when the objective requires a specific amount of something

- turrets and skrill now shoot at missiles

- added objective compass that shows the markers for the objective if any are available

- added inventory is full message. displays when looking at something that can be picked up but, (and you guessed it), your inventory is full 

- heavily optimized devices to only tick when needed and update at lower frequencies when possible

BALANCE

- increased entity scan range of missile launcher GUI to 15km instead of 3km

- missile launcher UI now shows which of the nearby entities are targeted by the holo-table or the cockpit/turret seats

- fixed missile prices on fort Bragg

- change some mission rewards, could profit 1.2M from abandoning mission in extreme cases

GRAPHICS

- pop-up with mission description upon receiving one

- added pop-up when you already have 5 missions (max) to mission terminal

BUG FIXES

- fixed crash in engineering terminal

- fixed bug where engineering terminal would sometimes select the wrong room

- fixed bug where engineering terminal would sometimes move incorrect items to other group

- fixed crash in Galaxy mode of holo-table

- fixed multiple spelling errors and other text bugs in mission texts

- added a back button to the cargo GUI in holo-table

- fixed bug where hydrogen tank did not update its damage texture/scenes

- fixed bug where skipping damage levels would also skip damage scenes

- fixed crash whilst removing cartridges from expansion bays that were removed during an upgrade of a ship

- doors now properly register as solid objects and are now targetable by Repair gun and G.R.I.P. instead of just the door frame

- dead players should no longer keep a ship populated

- offline players are now also moved to the new ship when going through a rift

- fixed crash in hacking terminal

- fixed editor menu being visible in screenshot mode for workshop

- fixed issue where trade station would keep adding ships to it's internal list every frame

- fixed some wrongly assigned faction station owners to Hurles Co. and GT Missions

- fixed crash on startup with high memory requirement ship loads

- optimized ship power system performance

- fixed several engine crashes on removing or adding entities

- fixed bug where game might claim load or generate failed while it didn't

- fixed refinery amount input field size

- fixed a bug with ships being removed if the uninhabited flag fails to accurately update

- offline players are now correctly updated when a ship moves through a rift

- fixed some station ownership messages with certain ships generated from missions

- fixed a bug with ships immediately disappearing after being retrieved from a store-o-tron

NOTES

- no rebuilding required unless you want to have the new version of the GT Trade Hub with the 3D printer wing

- servers need to be updated

notes.title: Incoming Transmission! – Interstellar Rift Development Update 075
notes.notes:
In this week’s update we have updated the tutorial, added a new mission log, and optimized ship devices for a smoother experience!

From the main menu when you select the tutorial you will start on a damaged ship which the new mission text and markers will help you fix. The tutorial will guide you through the basics of operating, maintaining and mining the resources for a ship. We are fairly confident that this tutorial is a massive upgrade from the previous one, and believe that it will give you a much better feel for the game and hopefully won’t leave you confused when you enter the game. This tutorial will help you through the basics of the game however we have plans to make some additional tutorials that will go more in depth about advanced flight mechanics, ship construction and combat. More on this in a future update.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/67e84cd2e8295e5c519b05f70e165e27cadc1225.png

These new missions markers and quest texts have also made its way into the rest of the mission system. When you accept a mission from a bulletin board you will get a step by step quest log that will let you easily keep track of where you are supposed to go and what you are supposed to do in order to complete these missions. The mission log can be toggled by pressing the mission log button (default key: L). These new mission tracking systems are currently only applied to missions which were previously in the game, however this system will enable us to make much more complicated multi stage missions in the future. 

Additionally we have pushed through a series of performance improvements as well as bug fixes that should help the game be much more stable and run better on lower end systems. We are still looking into the hiccups during saving and when someone joins a server. But rest assured in the knowledge that they are high on our list of priorities.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/d86b32f94acf8d2cc2d29dde3b4f3dd02ce933dd.png

Also in this patch are several improvements to the repair gun, such as different context based colors on its screen. For the full list of fixes, improvements and additions please see the patch notes.  

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you star side!

notes.title: A learning experience – Interstellar Rift Development Update 074
notes.notes:
In this week’s issue of experimental patches for Interstellar Rift, we revamped the tutorial and the entire mission log system. With these new changes we hope to make keeping track of your missions easier, and the game less daunting for new players.

Our main feature this week is the new tutorial, we’ve received a lot of feedback about the state of our old tutorial. And it has taken a while, but here we are with a new one. And we’d like your feedback on it. This tutorial is going to go through as many iterations as it takes in order to make it good enough for new players or old ones simply looking for a refresher course. Please let us know what you think and help us make a good first impression with this tutorial. Additions, changes, or just your general opinion about the tutorial is very welcome! Anything that will help us make it better!

Additionally we’ve added another slew of bug fixes and performance improvements.

For the full patch notes click here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/154643214753262799/

Thank you all for playing, we hope you’ll enjoy this new experimental update and we’ll see you starside!

notes.title: Cloudy with a chance of Missiles! – Interstellar Rift Development Update 073
notes.notes:
After a few days of simmering in the experimental branch we’re releasing patch: 0.1.35 into the wild! Bringing with it, missile launchers, a new resources, holotable improvements and more!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/626ff8cc33fd62cff8f30081e54228b0849ec224.png

First and foremost introducing the missile launcher! These weapons are placed in interior mode and can only be attached to an exterior wall much like windows and t2 engines! Each missile launcher can hold up to 4 missiles and can be fired from the console on the missile launcher or from the cockpit! There are two missile types the normal missiles do 1000 damage and travel at 600 m/s. These cost 40 Brass, 30 Steel, 70 Nitrous Oxide. The second missile type is the advanced missile and this one requires a new resource called TNP which can only be found on the Logicorp Chemical Plant. The total recipe is 40 Brass, 30 Steel, 100 TNP. These missiles do 10,000 damage and travel at 800m/s. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9b43754759eb67d3445be9467589c2e8e118f4a1.png

We’ve also overhauled the holotable’s system mode so that it’s more useful and easier to use. System mode will always have the sun in the centre of the display surrounded by the planets.
Everything that is orbiting that planet will be grouped under that planet and in order to see those object simply press E on that planet and it will expand revealing everything that orbits it. This way you can easily target objects from long distances. Ships and stations that are not orbiting a planet will be displayed on their own and their relative position will be visible in the main system mode view.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/9340400de8e5151af889d925028e929c0d2886ac.png

Additionally we’ve updated the gun with a new cross-hair that reacts to when you hit something giving more player feedback. We’ve also added a dedicated holster button (Default key: H), and added new messages that you get via in game mail. These tell you about any ships you might have lost and at what location you stored your ships. 

Thank you all for playing, we hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you starside!

notes.title: Fire ze missiles! – Interstellar Rift Development Update 072
notes.notes:
We have a new batch of features and fixes ready for testing on the experimental branch!

First up are missiles, which can be crafted in an assembling machine and fired from the new missile launchers. Missile launchers can hold up to 4 missiles and can be used to set a target and launch missiles at your command. Alternatively, missiles can also be fired from the helm of the ship when the launchers are preloaded. Missiles are made from 40 brass, 30 steel and 70 nitrous oxide, and deal a total of a 1000 damage.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3224fce57719a4205b38acc4d535a1564d3047bd.png

Missiles lock onto their target and will follow it until they hit the target, get destroyed while reaching it, or until their internal timer runs out and they self destruct. Missiles can also be found randomly on some stations, or bought at shops for around 6000 units per missile. 

Also in this patch is a major rework of how the holotable displays systems, planets with stations around them and other spatial features. The holotable will now zoom in and out of selected points of interest, and will try to group objects together to reduce clutter. 
Systems are now displayed with a relative scale, always showing the entire system by default and will zoom to specific groups and planets to reveal what more there might be located there. Galaxy mode has remained unchanged for now and ship mode is also mostly as you might remember it. 

Our main goal with this rework was improving visibility and ease of use. When we opened up the galaxy a couple of months back the holotable became almost unusable due to the sheer increase in size of the area it needed to display. The system mode will now always show the sun in the center of the map, the planets are projected around it and the stations around the planets. 

To make sure everything can be selected, ships neighbouring stations or other ships are displayed in a list like manner. To see the actual distance in relation to each other you can still use ship mode.

We’ve also updated the mailing system to notify you if any of your ships have been blown up, stored or otherwise removed from the galaxy. We are trying to track down any freak disappearances of ships that people have been reporting to happen. If you do receive mail that your ship has been removed when you are sure this should not have happened, please let us know. 

Some of the things in this update may be tweaked over the coming days, especially some of the values related to missiles. 

Thank you all for playing, we hope you’ll enjoy this new experimental update and we’ll see you starside!

- The Split Polygon Team

For detailed patch notes click here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/363360/discussions/4/215439774875472582/

[code]To enable the beta branch, right click on Interstellar Rift in Steam, go to the beta tab, and select the "experimental IR beta patches" option. 
We will have a test server up and running to try out these new features until the patch goes live for everyone later this week. 
Please keep in mind the test server will be wiped at the end of the beta period.[/code]

notes.title: Hot Shots! Part Deux – Interstellar Rift Development Update 071
notes.notes:
In this update we are enabling some more offensive and defensive capabilities as we add plasma pistols and meal packs, plus a healthy dose of bug fixes.

The new SI-3 Plasma Pistol by Sentinel Security Systems can now be printed in a 3D printer, as can the ammo that it fires. The plasma pistol can be used to destroy Eggnites, damage devices, and eliminate other players. It can be stored in a weapon rack, and the ammo can be kept in a locker. These weapons are disabled on starter stations however, preventing people from killing each other before they can reach their ships. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/a90712974f99d653529254693d51241177e57762.png

The plasma pistols have been available on the experimental branch for most of this week and during that time we have tweaked them a little. We have added recoil, tweaked the walking speed while aiming down sights, added sprinting animations, and tweaked the animation speeds. 

We have also (finally) introduced a way to heal. Food cartridges can now be printed from the 3D printer from Skrill meat. Each of these cartridges heals 10 per use and has 5 uses (a player has 100 health max). We are working on ways to allow for these to be obtained in other ways than printing them. Food cartridges can be stored in lockers as well. To use a food cartridge hold it in your hand and press and hold the left mouse button down. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/29b43f80695b592ef98011ec9c4ebc1c3ee546cd.png

Also in this update, we have been working on tweaking the way resources spawn in the galaxy. The system map now accurately shows the spawn rates of resources in those systems. Before this change there could be discrepancies between the values shown on the system map due to multiple random values working on top of each other. 

What this means for you guys is that some rare resources now no longer spawn in Hadron. There is still a chance for beryllium to spawn, as well as gold and platinum. To find the other rare resources you will have to travel to other systems. To offset this change they are now much more abundant in those systems as they now have a chance to spawn in every field in that system. What we hope to achieve with this change is less reliance on random values to find resources, and more on using scanners and holotables. 

We have also been working on localization. We hope to be able to release the option to translate the game, and share that translation with the community, within a couple of updates.

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you starside!

notes.title: Hot shots! - Interstellar Rift Development Update 070
notes.notes:
Welcome to a new experimental update! This time we are introducing the plasma pistol as the first of our handheld arsenal.

From now on you will be able to construct guns and ammunition in the 3D printer. We are still heavily tweaking all the values but feel like the pistols are ready to be tested by everyone who downloads the experimental branch (instructions below). 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3422824d78bdad65f65fee1eaf17f0aaaa66109f.png
The crafting recipe for a pistol is; 50 brass, 50 steel, and 25 silicon

The recipe for ammunition is; 25 iron, 25 nitrous oxide, and 50 hydrogen. 

Every ammo cartridge contains 12 shots and there are 6 cartridges in a printed package.

Furthermore this patch is still heavily focused on bugfixes and performance optimizations, which will be a common theme in upcoming patches. For a complete list of all the fixes and more, see the patch notes.

We have stripped the stations clean from all their festive halloween decorations, but everything you’ve built will remain on your ships, and you will keep any candy and pumpkins. 

There will be added new content in the final version of this patch later this week, but we mainly wanted to focus the experimental branch on this first step into onboard combat.

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook or you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new experimental update and we’ll see you starside!

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.33
notes.notes:
FUNCTIONALITIES

- upgraded chat
	chat can now be scaled (75%, 100%, 125%), and autoscales on resolution
	autocomplete on usernames, by pressing tab
	pasting now works

notes.title: Stellar Stability - Interstellar Rift Development Update 068
notes.notes:
The theme for this update has been stability and desync fixes. The majority of time has been spent on fixing crashes and fixing several bugs and ironing out some other issues.

We have also added in a much requested feature; no combat zones around the faction starter stations.
These are there to prevent spawn camping and griefing. In a radius of 3km around these stations your ships weapons simply won't function. These new zones are still under review and we will adjust them when/if necessary.

Additionally the repair tool now has third person animations, which means that you can now see other people using their repair tools. The repair beams have also been added to the repair drone to make it clearer as to which ship they are repairing. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/292c8f98647cf5b6b9f077276cd86516bb55c61d.png

We’ve also further improved the space flight marker compass with the ability to filter out certain types of markers. Debris now also has individual markers making it easier to track loot from destroyed ships and aliens.

We have also updated the chat box GUI, which will now scale with screen resolution and has a few extra upgrades such as CTRL-V capability and autocomplete on usernames when TAB is pressed. Clicking on a username will now automatically set the chat to whisper the next message to them.

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook or you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you starside!

notes.title: Patch notes for Interstellar Rift ALPHA 0.1.32
notes.notes:
FUNCTIONALITIES

- reworked point of interest indicators in the ship flight interface
	
	indicators now rotate around a circle instead of the edge of the screen
	indicator text labels no longer stack on top of each other but form a stack which expands when hovered over
	indicators that point to objects behind the ship now show a small arrow indicator
	targets can now be deselected by pressing "Y" (hotkey rebind option incoming)
		
- other players now display an animation when the GRIP is in use

- thrusters and enigines can now be damaged

- added repair drones
	
	can be bought at trade stations or assembled in the assembling machine
	resource cost are 150 brass, 300 iron, 150 silicon
	repair drones can be activated by ejecting them out of a disposer and retrieved with a salvager
	repair drones need iron to function and can hold 1800 iron or 3 full crates
	repair drones have the ability to find iron in space, to load a repair drone eject a crate of iron from a disposer. Then from the sensor list on a terminal a drone can be set to collect iron, the drone will search for iron in the vicinity
	repair drones can be set to repair any ship in the vicinity through the sensor tab on a terminal
	they have a follow function which will follow any target ship untill it goes outside of a 4km range
	
- added new enemy, Skrill Hunter
	
	is much faster than the Skrill Grunt
	fires two projectiles, a standard damage projectile and sometime an Eggnite projectile
	Eggnite projectiles form Eggnites on the ship which attach to energy related devices such as; generators, batteries, and power cells, which they will proceed to drain
	Eggnites can be destroyed with the damage beam of a repair gun or by repairing the ship at a HydroPEX service depot or at a Store-o-Tron
	
- added engineering terminal
	
	engineering terminal can be found under prop edit mode > systems
	gives the option to create and delete power groups while walking around on the ship
	gives the option to transfer devices between power groups
	gives the option to view devices on a group and room level
	gives the option to enable and disable all devices, airflow, and doors on a room level
	cannot disable itself
	gives an overview per device where the status and health is displayed and the device can be turned on and off
	
- added some more mission titles and resources

- teleporters can now be turned off and on with the GRIP

- you can now press the up and down arrow keys in the chat to cycle between your previous messages

BALANCE

- rebalanced mission rewards (mostly for missions that have objectives in other systems), are now much more rewarding and many give resources needed to travel from system to system

- rebalanced Skrill Grunt spawn rates	
	
GRAPHICS

- other players now have more noticable look animations

- added images for all missing devices in the information kiosk	

SOUND

- rebalanced volume of music

- rebalanced fading times of music

BUG FIXES

- optimized the spawning and despawning of damage effect particles

- fixed an issue with player first person animations where they would be 1 frame off

- fixed bug where warp charge could not be cancelled

- fixed bug where firing animation of repair gun loops forever

- fixed /r in chat sending messages to the wrong person

NOTES

- servers need to be updated and restarted, and the rules need to be rebuilt with the first option of the rebuilding options in the F8 admin menu

notes.title: Engineering a Skrill infestation - Interstellar Rift Development Update 067
notes.notes:
After wednesday’s appetiser on the experimental branch it is time for the main course. This patch introduces a brand new Skrill enemy, the hunter!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/f95806d9fecf436d6f81c424b4e151f27fa92228.png

This skrill is most commonly found in packs with skrill grunts. However it is much faster than the grunts and it has a special attack that can cripple ships by infesting the ships with eggnites. These creatures attach themselves to a ship's power generation devices and partially drain them of power which can cause some systems to run much less efficiently. Which can make you an easier target for the skrill grunts since the hunter itself doesn't do much damage. Fortunately these eggnite projectiles cannot go through shields so make sure to keep them up if you don’t want your ship to be infested. Additionally hunters also dramatically boost the aggression of all other skrill around them. So don't think you’re going to be safe if you’re in a large ship now as these creatures will now attack you as well.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/be323cc6bacff8134e6aa11beac52bfcb03d7c7e.png

The eggheads at Logicorp have created a new terminal which lets you control individual systems from a single terminal. Its primary functions include the ability to switch power groups on the fly so if you have damaged or destroyed generators you can now transfer power from an intact generator to this damaged group. Additionally you can also control the life support systems for every room through the engineering terminal, making it a little easier to cut off life support to certain sections of the ship which you are not using or use it for some more nefarious activities.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/6e8a09bfc5a671cd254e1aedadc445d3f942eddd.png

Another major addition is the inclusion of repair drones. With this we are giving players the ability to repair hull and engine damage. These drones can be launched using a disposer and then be controlled by use of a normal terminal through the sensor menu. In order for a drone to do its job it will have to be loaded with iron. Which means that you will have to eject a crate of iron along with the drone and then tell it to grab it from the drone menu. Now the drone is ready to repair and follow any target that you give it. The repair drones have a maximum follow range of 4 kilometers and they will go into sleep mode if they are ever out of range and stop following your ship.

These busy little bee’s can be built in the assembler using iron, brass and silicon.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/3d485765e2ca478ee1326b3955c08269843108dc.png

As a final cherry on top we have overhauled the cockpit marker compass to now be constrained in a circle instead of the edges of the screen. This should make finding your targets much easier as we’ve also changed up the way we display markers which are on top of each other. They will now expand and display all of the text in one or two lists around the target marker. Additionally targets which are behind you will also have a secondary arrow next to them indicating that they are behind your ship, and you now have the ability to deselect targets by pressing “Y” (rebindable in the options menu).  In upcoming updates we will also add filter options to give pilots even more control over their interface.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8953533/2947af8bc49217f9ce35ffea8217db9a93caaa85.png

We have noticed some issues with performance and networking when playing multi-player, and we will be focussing on resolving these issues over the coming weeks. This might however limit the amount of new functionalities in the next update, but we feel like focussing our efforts on a smoother and more stable playing experience should be top priority.

Thank you all for playing and if you want to stay up to date with all Interstellar Rift news you can follow us on Twitter, Facebook or you’re free to leave your thoughts on our forums! We hope you’ll enjoy this new update and we’ll see you starside!

- The Split Polygon Team

notes.title: Experimental Engineering - Interstellar Rift Development Update 066
notes.notes:
Time for another experimental update. We feel that these experimental updates have resulted in much more stable patches these past few weeks so we have decided to keep doing them.

With this update we are adding in the long awaited Engineering Terminal. With this device you will be able to change power groups on the fly as well as take control of individual room functions such as life support and door locks. 

Additionally, the repair drone has been added and along with that engine and thruster damage. You can deploy a repair drone through a disposal unit. The drones require (refined) Iron in order to repair your hull and engines. You will also have to eject a crate of iron and tell the drones to pick it up. After which it will use those resources to repair your external devices. These drones can be controlled from a standard wall terminal. They can also be picked back up with a salvager.

Additionally, a new alien threat has awakened, the mysterious Skrill swarms have released their Skrill hunters. These aliens are fast and their objective is to slow you down. They have a special attack which will cause eggnite infestors to burrow into your ships and attach themselves onto your power generators and storage devices. They will drain power from them in order to slow you down so the rest of the slower Skrill can catch up and destroy your ship. To combat this infestation you can use your repair tool's laser cutter (right mouse button) to kill the creatures. The hunters will only spawn in systems with a skrill rating of 3500 and above.

We have also reworked the space flight target markers to make it easier to read when there are multiple markers in the distance which are stacked ontop of eachother. As well as a new marker compass which now constrains in a circle rather than to the edges of the screen to make it easier to see in which direction some markers are.

We hope you enjoy this experimental patch and please let us know what you think and any problems that you find. This helps us get rid of those pesky bugs before we push towards the live version.

As usual, the experimental patch notes can be found here:
Patch notes for experimental patch e0.1.32

To enable the beta branch, right click on Interstellar Rift in Steam, go to the beta tab, and select the "experimental IR beta patches" option. 

We will have some test servers up and running to try out these new features until the patch goes live for everyone later this week. 

Please keep in mind these will be wiped at the end of the beta period. 

See you star side!

The Split Polygon Team
